Captain William Clark named the spot “that dismal little nitch.” For six stormy days, the group was trapped by fierce wind and high waves at the rocky shoreline. Today the spot boasts a beautiful view of the Columbia river, interpretive panels, and a…

activities.name: Explore a Cave
activities.description: Explore Craters' dynamic underground world of lava tubes.

activities.name: Trail Run Grandview Rim Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (This trail could take anywhere from 20 minutes to 2 hours, depending on the person. )
activities.duration: This trail could take anywhere from 20 minutes to 2 hours, depending on the person.
activities.description: Trail run that is 3.1 miles. This is an out and back route that is on different compositions. It is mostly a dirt path with varying degrees of hardness. In fall, when leaves are falling, be aware that the leaves can block view of any dips in the trail terrain.

activities.name: Living History
activities.description: A living history talk is presented by a staff member who portrays a person who actually lived during 1865 and shares with visitors what he or she experienced around the time of the surrender. These talks are typically from April-October.

activities.name: Watch the "Spirit of Yosemite" Film
activities.description: The park film, The Spirit of Yosemite, is shown daily on the hour and the half hour in the theater behind the Yosemite Exploration Center. The first showing is at 9:30am, and the last showing is at 4pm.

activities.name: Hike Deadhorse Trail - North Rim
activities.description: Deadhorse Trail takes hikers into the Black Canyon of the Gunnison Wilderness Area. It offers good views of Deadhorse Gulch and East Portal on the Gunnison River, as well as good birding.

activities.name: Experience History Come Alive at Fort Clatsop
activities.description: Visit the replica fort and visitor center to learn more about the Lewis & Clark expedition and local native culture. If you visit during our Summer or Winter programs you may even get to talk to rangers in costumes and try your hand at 19th century tasks. Experience this incredible story in a tangible way when you lay…

activities.name: Wildlife Watching - Government Island
activities.description: Located in Stafford, VA, this section of trail offers a boardwalk through a freshwater wetland and marsh habitat and a loop around a forested island. There are abundant opportunities for bird watching and wildlife viewing all times of year.

activities.name: Birding at Flamingo
activities.description: Flamingo offers ample birding opportunities along its many trail areas as well as around the visitor center and marina. The mix of mangrove and coastal prairie habitats host a bounty of wading birds, shorebirds and waterbirds throughout the year. Additionally, there is always the chance of seeing tropical marine life…

activities.name: Green River Ferry to Houchin Ferry
activities.basis: estimated from duration (4-6 Hours)
activities.description: This longer section of the Green River is less traveled then the popular Dennison Ferry to Green River Ferry trip.

activities.name: Hike Rim Rock Trail - South Rim
activities.description: This 1-mile (1.6 km) trail, which meanders along the canyon rim, connects the South Rim Visitor Center to the South Rim Campground.

activities.name: Hiking at Fort Pulaski
activities.description: Fort Pulaski has several trails for you to explore!

activities.name: View the Overlooks at the Canyon Rim Visitor Center
activities.basis: estimated from duration (0-30 Minutes)
activities.description: Canyon Rim Visitor Center overlooks for the New River Gorge Bridge and the New River Gorge

activities.name: Discover the Lodgepole-Sherman Tree Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-5 Hours)
activities.description: Explore the Giant Forest on your way to the General Sherman Tree. Take the 2.8 mile Lodgepole-Sherman Tree Trail from the Lodgepole Campground, then catch the Green Route 1 shuttle back to the parking lot.

activities.name: Hike the Buffalo River Trail in the Lower District
activities.description: The Buffalo River Trail (BRT) is ideal for a 5-6 mile day hike or as a backcountry camping destination.

activities.name: Hike to Alum Cave Bluffs
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Hike 4.6 miles (7.4 km) roundtrip to see the Alum Cave Bluffs and stroll through Arch Rock on this popular hike on Alum Cave Trail. The trail crosses two mountain streams via footbridges before it climbs through sections of old-growth forest.

activities.name: Sports and Recreation at Anacostia
activities.description: Come play basketball or tennis on one of our courts, or start a game of frisbee or soccer on one of our open fields that is along the scenic Anacostia River!

activities.name: Swimming at Amistad
activities.description: Swimming and playing in the water at Governors Landing, and throughout the park, is popular during Amistad National Recreation Area's hot summers. Swimming is allowed throughout the park except at mooring locations, designated fishing locations, and boat ramps.

activities.name: Greenstone Section 1: Hike from Lookout Louise to Mount Franklin
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1 Day)
activities.description: This secluded section of the Greenstone Ridge Trail reaches to the northeastern tip of Isle Royale. Mileage: About 5 miles

activities.name: Chihuahuan Desert Nature Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30 Minutes)
activities.description: Enjoy views of the Guadalupe Mountains and explore Chihuahuan Desert plant life along this short 0.7 mile (1.1 km) loop trail.

activities.name: Jones Run Falls
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-3 Hours)
activities.description: Jones Run Parking Area (mile 84.1) | This hike takes you over a mountain stream, through the forest, and beside a 42’ waterfall.

activities.name: Fish in Valle San Antonio
activities.description: San Antonio Creek is famous throughout New Mexico for wild brown trout and beautiful scenery. Reserve your backcountry vehicle pass to fish this stream seasonally from May 15 - November 15.

activities.name: Henry Hill Loop Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Henry Hill Loop is a easy 1.1 mile trail that encompasses the area of the most intense fighting during the First Battle of Manassas. Rickett's Battery, Jackson's Line, the Robinson Farm, and more are all part of this interpretive trail.

activities.name: Hiking in Colorado National Monument
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Colorado National Monument trails offer a hike for everyone from 0.25 mile to over 14 miles, from flat accessible surfaces to rugged canyons.

activities.name: Paddling North Maumee to Spring Creek
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-4 Hours)
activities.description: This typically quiet and calm piece of river takes you past Maumee Bluff and Schoolhouse Ridge before approaching Spring Creek itself, Spring Creek Bluff, and the Spring Creek access point and primitive campground. This 4.7-mile stretch of river has a decent shuttle trip of approximately 45 minutes (20 miles).

activities.name: Watch Vicksburg National Military Park's Orientation Film
activities.description: This orientation film plays every half hour at the park's visitor center.

activities.name: Bike on the Tour Road
activities.basis: estimated from duration (45-180 Minutes)
activities.description: Experience the landscape of one of the pivotal battles of the Revolution. You can use the same tour stop points as the cars. Bikes are not permitted on the footpaths and Historic New Garden Road. The Tour Road is 2.25 miles long, looping around the park. You will begin in the Visitor Center parking lot, cross Old…

activities.name: Hawksbill Summit via Upper Hawksbill
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: MILE 46.5 | A hike to the top of Shenandoah’s highest peak, offering 360-degree views of the Shenandoah Valley, the Blue Ridge Mountains, and the Virginia Piedmont.

activities.name: Watch Iron Works on the Saugus
activities.description: The Saugus Iron Works official park film provides an overview of the creation, operation and historical significance of Saugus Iron Works in the 17th century.

activities.name: Tour Vanderbilt Mansion
activities.description: Everything you need to know about access to the Vanderbilt Mansion and how to obtain your tickets. Tour days and times change seasonally, so check here for more information on planning your visit.

activities.name: Become an Upper Delaware Junior Ranger
activities.description: Become a Junior Ranger at Upper Delaware Scenic and Recreational River. The Junior Ranger program is a great way for individuals of all ages to learn about the river, its natural resources, and the history of the Upper Delaware River Valley.

activities.name: Kūpinaʻi Pali (Waldron Ledge)
activities.basis: estimated from duration (45-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Walk along an old road damaged by an earthquake in 1983 and get panoramic views of Kaluapele

activities.name: Explore Wildflowers at Cedar Sink
activities.basis: estimated from duration (45-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Stunning rock faces, cave springs, and geological panoramas, you will experience a wide array of seasonal wildflowers and biodiversity.

activities.name: Explore the Visitor Center
activities.description: Learn about Washita Battlefield through the park visitor center

activities.name: Hike the Roanoke River Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The ideal hike for someone who likes water, bridges, woods—and doesn’t feel like committing an entire afternoon to a hike. Roanoke River Trail is an an easy trail that covers less than a mile. It makes a perfect leg stretcher hike as you pass through Roanoke.

activities.name: Bridge Loop Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3-6 Hours)
activities.description: This 8-mile loop hike will take you on an adventure through the northern section of Rock Creek Park. In addition, you will cross over five of the named bridges that cross Rock Creek.

activities.name: Go Mountain Biking in Cuyahoga Valley
activities.basis: estimated from duration (20-60 Minutes)
activities.description: The East Rim Trail system has stunning views, varied terrain, exciting obstacles, and an element of adventure for intermediate mountain bikers.

activities.name: Visit the historic Frijole Ranch
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Frijole Ranch is a delightful oasis on the edge of the dry, lower slopes of the Guadalupe escarpment which truly captures the rugged sprit of the American West. Today the Frijole Ranch History Museum occupies the old ranch headquarters and displays the human history of the Guadalupes. The grounds are open from dusk to…

activities.name: Visit the Yosemite Exploration Center
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Yosemite Exploration Center features interactive displays and exhibits highlighting Yosemite's many stories and resources. Bring the family and learn more about Yosemite's history, the people who originally called this place home, as well as more about meadows, animals, and sequoias!

activities.name: Footprints Area
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Traverse the rugged Kaʻū Desert and see footprints left by Native Hawaiians long ago.

activities.name: Visit Antietam National Battlefield Visitor Center
activities.description: The should be the first stop for every visitor to Antietam. Rangers and volunteers provide maps and information to help you get off on the right path for your visit.

activities.name: Winter Fun at Saratoga
activities.description: Learn about fun winter activities as Saratoga National Historical Park!

activities.name: Hike the Shoshone ADA Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Shoshone ADA trail is a small section of one of Great Basin's longer hiking routes. This 0.1 mile stretch takes visitors to a wooden platform and fishing area right on Snake Creek. Caution: Access may be difficult for modified vehicles with low clearance.

activities.name: Fishing in Sitka
activities.description: Fishing is a popular tradition in Sitka. Fish responsibly, follow regulations, and have a license when necessary. Be aware that bears share fishing grounds in the park and know what to do to keep yourself and the bears safe.

activities.name: Discovering Life at Fort Scott
activities.description: Living History Programs

activities.name: Bartram Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (20-40 Minutes)
activities.description: A 3/4th mile hike through woods between the Southeast Mound and the Visitor Center.

activities.name: Bat Flight Program
activities.description: Enjoy an evening ranger talk about the park's population of Brazilian Free-tailed Bats and experience their emergence from Carlsbad Cavern.

activities.name: Moose
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Four subspecies of moose (Alces alces) exist in North America. The subspecies in Glacier is the Shiras moose (A. a. shirasi) and is found in forested areas and willow flats from southeastern British Columbia to northern Colorado. Moose are better adapted to survival in deep snow than other ungulates in the park, and…

activities.name: Find the Gravesites of Revolutionary War Soldiers
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Locate the gravestones of Revolutionary War soldiers at Gloria Dei Church National Historic Site. Explore the churchyard virtually from home, or pick up a map at the church door and take a stroll through the grounds.

activities.name: Become a Biscayne Junior Ranger
activities.description: Join Diego the dolphin, Peter the panther and Aleesha the alligator in exploring three South Florida parks (Big Cypress National Preserve, and Biscayne and Everglades National Park). Pick up a booklet at the park visitor center and complete the required activities to earn a badge. Complete the entire book and earn…

activities.name: Hike Precipice Loop
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Rising over 1,000 feet in 0.9 miles, the Precipice Trail requires physical and mental strength. It is a rugged, non-technical climb with open cliff faces and iron rungs, and reaches the summit of Champlain Mountain.

activities.name: Locomotive Ranger Program
activities.description: Experience the wonder of classic Victorian steam locomotives and be transported back in time to 1869 when America was newly united the world's first transcontinental railroad. The locomotives will run along approximately two miles of the historic grade where visitors will have the opportunity smell, hear, see and feel…

activities.name: Hike the Cerro Seco Loop
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Cerro Seco Loop is a strenuous, 11.2-mile round-trip hike that circles a lava dome with fantastic views of the caldera's north rim. It takes 5-6 hours to complete. Pets are not permitted.

activities.name: Paddling Mt. Hersey to Woolum
activities.basis: estimated from duration (4 Hours)
activities.description: This reach provides numerous bluffs, shoals and pools along the way.

activities.name: Nāhuku Lava Tube Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-90 Minutes)
activities.description: Walk through lush rainforest and see a cave where a river of lava flowed 500 years ago.

activities.name: Hike Little River Trail
activities.description: Once a railroad bed, the Little River Trail now offers a peaceful hike through the Elkmont area of Great Smoky Mountains National Park. As you follow the river’s gentle flow, you’ll pass remnants of the old Elkmont community—stone chimneys and foundations quietly tucked into the forest.

activities.name: Experience the Shafer Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Shafer Trail is a challenging, unpaved backcountry road for recreational users seeking the experience of a lifetime. High-clearance 4WD vehicles with a low range gear (4LO) are required. ATVs, OHVs, or UTVs are not permitted inside the park.

activities.name: Discover Theodore Roosevelt Island
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-3 Hours)
activities.description: Theodore Roosevelt Island is a memorial that honors the legacy of a great outdoorsman and conservationist. Learn about America’s 26th president, and the diverse human and natural history of the island.

activities.name: Bike the Anacostia River Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-4 Hours)
activities.description: 3.5 mile bike trail along the Anacostia River. This trail continues North into Maryland and across two bridges into downtown D.C.

activities.name: Hike The Little Mo Nature Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-45 Minutes)
activities.description: Take a short hike along the Little Mo Nature Trail and learn about the nature and geology of Theodore Roosevelt National Park!

activities.name: Explore Washington’s Gristmill and Distillery Buildings
activities.description: Explore George Washington’s enterprising Distillery and Gristmill ® on the extended Mount Vernon Estate. Washington’s ambitious and profitable Gristmill used groundbreaking technology in the 1790’s, and provided staple foods for the house, enslaved servicemen and women of the house.

activities.name: Birdwatch at Rio Grande Village Nature Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (15-45 Minutes)
activities.description: Rio Grande Village is consistently one of the best places to find a large number of birds in Big Bend National Park. The principal area to search is the Nature Trail, located in the southeastern corner of the campground.

activities.name: Hike the Harpers Corner Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: 2 miles (3.2 km) round trip, out and back trail. Moderate difficulty. The Harpers Corner Trail runs along a narrow ridge to a spectacular viewpoint with views of the rivers far below. Along the way, hikers can gaze across the remote canyon country. A pamphlet for this trail is available at the Visitor Centers. The…

activities.name: Start at the Fort Monroe Visitor & Education Center
activities.description: Start at the Fort Monroe Visitor & Education Center Pick up a park brochure, ticket for the Casemate Museum, and a self-guiding walking tour. Stamp your Passport to Your National Parks. Kids can get their Junior Ranger activity book. Plan your visit with the information desk staff. See exhibits to learn about the…

activities.name: Walk Around The Jean Baptiste Vallé Gardens
activities.description: The rose gardens are open daily to visitors year round. Through many generations, and different families, the rose gardens have been cultivated extensively into what they are today. It is a perfect place to go when you need to stop and smell the roses.

activities.name: Mansion Tours
activities.description: Learn how you can tour the Hampton mansion!

activities.name: Visit the Roosevelt Gravesite at Youngs Memorial Cemetery
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Youngs Memorial Cemetery is a small cemetery in the village of Oyster Bay, New York. Theodore Roosevelt, the twenty-sixth President of the United States, his wife Edith Roosevelt, and other Roosevelt family members are buried at Youngs Cemetery. It is located approximately one and a half miles south of Sagamore Hill…

activities.name: Hike Neversink Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: This short trail is located nearest to Gunnison along the Gunnison River and provides good birdwatching opportunities.

activities.name: Watch the Sunrise from Derby Wharf
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Enjoy an East Coast sunrise from Derby Wharf! The horizon is broad and flat, providing an expansive view of Salem Harbor.

activities.name: Art in the Landscape
activities.description: The landscape around Longfellow House-Washington's Headquarters has inspired artists for generations. Bring your own preferred materials to paint or draw en plain air!

activities.name: Hike to Wheeler Peak
activities.basis: estimated from duration (4-10 Hours)
activities.description: Hike the tallest peak in the park at 13,063 feet tall. This tough, nearly 9 mile round trip hike will reward those who summit with perhaps the best views in the state.

activities.name: Little Devils Stairs Loop
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: MILE 19.4 | A journey into a rocky gorge with some very rewarding, yet steep, sections along a stream.

activities.name: Painted Cove Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (10-30 Minutes)
activities.description: The Painted Cove Trail is 0.25 mi (0.4 km) roundtrip. The Painted Cove is an amazing color palette of vibrant rocks. A portion of this trail features a level boardwalk to cross over sensitive soils. Please stay on the designated trail.

activities.name: Play the Virtual Glass Armonica
activities.description: Of all his inventions, the one Benjamin Franklin enjoyed most was the glass armonica. Give it a try at the Benjamin Franklin Museum, where you can explore Franklin's life and legacy through his character traits (fee applies).

activities.name: Birding on the Natchez Trace Parkway
activities.description: Birding on the Natchez Trace Parkway

activities.name: Hike Bench Trail to Balconies Cave Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: East Side Trails, Moderate Hikes, Cave Hike

activities.name: Explore Anishinaabe (Ojibwe) Culture
activities.description: Learn about Anishinaabe (Ojibwe) culture past and present. Explore the art and craft of the Grand Portage community with many museum objects on display, including tools for woodworking and gathering maple sugar, a cradleboard, a drum, beaded items, and more.

activities.name: Exploring Huffman Prairie Flying Field
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Visit the site where aviation history was born, Huffman Prairie Flying Field. Visitors can explore the area and view a replica hangar that is similar to the one which the Wrights used to house their airplanes. A sprawling prairie also offers visitors a chance to stroll and explore nature too.

activities.name: Walk the Rim Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Rim Trail stretches from its beginning in the south at Bryce Point 5.5 miles (8.9 km) north to Fairyland Point. As it follows the edge of the Bryce Amphitheater area of the park, it connects to Inspiration Point, Sunset Point, and Sunrise Point providing a relatively easy hike (depending on how much of it you do)…

activities.name: Beginner's Guide to Snowshoeing
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Mount Rainier National Park is a great place for beginner and experienced snowshoers to explore the winter landscape.

activities.name: Hanford: Picnic and Play in Rodney Block Park
activities.description: Rodney Block Park in Richland, Washington, was originally created as a place to play and relax for the Manhattan Project workers and their families who lived in the alphabet homes that surround the park. Today, the park is still a place for recreation that draws people of all ages.

activities.name: Drive the Saturiwa Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (20-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Take a drive through 6,000 years of history on Fort George Island.

activities.name: Hike Beech Cliff Trail with Island Explorer Bus
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Beech Cliff Trail climbs a steep rock face from the southern end of Echo Lake to the top of the cliffs. Continue north along the short and fun Beech Cliff Loop to be treated to even more views from the top of the cliffs. The descent is more gradual and goes down a forested area via the Canada Cliffs Trail back to…

activities.name: Visit Badwater Basin
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Badwater Basin is the lowest elevation in North America at - 282 feet (- 86 m) below sea level. A visit to this otherworldly salt flat will provide you with a unique experience and a landscape that appears to stretch on forever. A short 1/4 mile (400 m) hike will you bring you to the polygon salt formations that Death…

activities.name: Road Biking on Rim Rock Drive
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Road biking the 23-mile Rim Rock Drive offers cyclists a challenging ride with stunning views.

activities.name: Hike to Avalanche Lake
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3-6 Hours)
activities.description: Hiking to Avalanche Lake provides an excellent introduction to Glacier.

activities.name: Red Line - DC Metro
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Days)
activities.description: Embrace the outdoors, explore interactive exhbits and stand where history happened by taking the Red Line to visit some of DC's National Park Sites. Each of the parks listed here are 1 mile or less from each metro stop (about a 20 minute walk) or a 10 minute bus ride away.

activities.name: Hike Smokemont Nature Trail
activities.description: Hike 0.62-mile (1 km) roundtrip on Smokemont Nature Trail which provides a peaceful escape and views of the surrounding peaks.

activities.name: Cedar Run - Whiteoak Circuit
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Hawksbill Gap Parking Area (mile 45.6) | This hike is very challenging, although those who do it are rewarded with exceptional cascades and waterfalls. You will also hike through the Shenandoah Wilderness along the Cedar Run Trail.

activities.name: Wildlife Viewing in the Caldera
activities.description: Valles Caldera provides excellent habitat for a wide variety of animals, and there are plenty of opportunities for viewing wildlife like elk, bears, prairie dogs, coyotes, and birds.

activities.name: Hanford: Visit the REACH Museum
activities.description: At The REACH Museum, you can learn about the natural and human history of the Tri-Cities. The museum houses rotating and permanent exhibits, including a robust exhibit on the Manhattan Project and Cold War.

activities.name: South River Falls
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-3 Hours)
activities.description: MILE 62.7 | From the South River Picnic Grounds, this route is a circuit hike that takes you to an observation point overlooking an 83’ waterfall. A great hike for wildflower and bird enthusiasts, alike!

activities.name: Natural Bridge Bike Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-3 Hours)
activities.description: The Natural Bridge bike trail is 2.5 mi (4km) round-trip ride and begins just south of the Bridge Bay marina off the Grand Loop Road.

activities.name: Become a Junior Ranger at Walnut Canyon
activities.description: Join Miguel the Mule Deer in exploring the human history, geology, and wildlife of Walnut Canyon National Monument and earn a Jr. Ranger badge.

activities.name: Hiking the Yockanookany Section of the Natchez Trace National Scenic Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-15 Hours)
activities.description: North of Jackson, Mississippi the Yockanookany section of the Natchez Trace National Scenic Trail is the longest of the five developed trail sections at 26 miles. Eight miles run alongside the Ross R. Barnett Reservoir, and the other sixteen miles go through dense forests, seasonal streams and open pastureland.

activities.name: Junior Ranger Activity Book
activities.description: The Junior Ranger program is a great way to learn more about President William Jefferson Clinton Birthplace Home National Historic Site. Anyone can become a Junior Ranger by completing activities either during a visit to the park or by mail.

activities.name: Austin, Texas Area: El Camino Real de los Tejas NHT Places
activities.description: Explore sites along the trail! Looking for places to visit near San Antonio, Texas? These sites offer a variety of hikes, historic sites, museums, and other ways to take a step back in time on El Camino Real de los Tejas NHT.

activities.name: Guided Tour of Tao House
activities.description: *Please note: The Eugene O'Neill National Historic Site must be accessed through a private, gated road owned by a community of neighboring residents. In order to experience the Eugene O'Neill National Historic Site, therefore, visitors need to make reservations at least 24 hours in advance and will be driven by a park…

activities.name: Quilt Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-180 Minutes)
activities.description: Quilt Block: Joseph's Coat

activities.name: Become a Lowell Junior Ranger
activities.description: Participating in the Junior Ranger Program is a fun way for young visitors to get the most out of their visit to Lowell National Historical Park. Free activity books can be picked up at the Boott Cotton Mills Museum (115 John Street). Participants can earn a badge and a certificate after completing a few simple, fun…

activities.name: Lower Rattlesnake Canyon Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3 Hours)
activities.description: Follow down a canyon for 3 miles (4.8 km) and enjoy a variety of Chihuahuan Desert plants.

activities.name: Hike the Mitchell Hill Moderate Loop
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Mitchell Hill Moderate Loop incorporates some of the best trail segments along a slightly more challenging route. The trail takes you through a dense cedar grove and to the top of Mitchell Hill.

activities.name: Hike to Laurel Falls
activities.description: Hike 2.6 miles (4.2 km) roundtrip through a mixed hardwood forest to an 80-foot (24-m) waterfall. Enjoy a few views of the mountain landscape before arriving at the waterfall. PLEASE NOTE: Laurel Falls Trail is expected to close starting in mid-December for 18 months.

activities.name: Birding Jordan Pond
activities.description: Explore Jordan Pond before the crowds by searching for breeding loon and songbirds in the morning at this popular Acadia destination.

activities.name: Hike the Acadia Mountain Loop with Island Explorer Bus
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-3 Hours)
activities.description: Acadia Mountain Trail follows up the east and west side of the mountain with views of the surrounding mountains and bodies of water. With the Island Explorer bus, visitors won't need to park along the road and can ride to the trailhead stress-free.

activities.name: Keanakākoʻi
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Walk along an old portion of Crater Rim Drive to Keanakāko'i Crater and views toward the massive Halemaʻumaʻu.

activities.name: Blue Blazes Whiskey Still Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (20-30 Minutes)
activities.description: As you travel along the Blue Blazes creek, interpretive trailside signs explore stream ecology and the history of whiskey production on Catoctin Mountain during the time of Prohibition. The trail concludes at an actual whiskey still.

activities.name: View the Night Sky at Capulin Volcano
activities.description: View the night sky at a volcano! Capulin Volcano National Monument is a International Dark Sky Place, which means thousands of stars are visible in the night sky. On Saturday evenings during the summer, rangers conduct dark sky programs here.

activities.name: Backcountry Camping in Canyonlands
activities.description: What better way to connect with this wilderness of countless canyons than on foot? Canyonlands offers hundreds of miles of hiking trails with designated campsites for overnight backcountry travel.

activities.name: If You Have 2-3 Hours
activities.description: Driving through? Stop to stretch your legs at the Heritage Center and Historic Depot to view exhibits about Anishinaabe (Ojibwe) culture and where you learn about a time when the fur trade dominated North American commerce.

activities.name: Tour the North Rim Road
activities.description: The North Rim is reached by taking a gravel road from the east end of Crawford State Park. The North Rim Road provides access to 6 overlooks. The canyon walls on the North Rim are almost vertical, offering impressive views.

activities.name: Junior Ranger of the Monument
activities.description: Become a Junior Ranger of Colorado National Monument by completing a booklet (pick up at Saddlehorn Visitor Center) to earn your badge.

activities.name: Hike the Bull Canyon Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: 3 miles (4.8 km) round trip. Difficult. Bull Canyon is a steep, unmaintained trail in a remote section of the monument. It begins on the Yampa Bench Road and takes hikers into the Harding Hole area along the Yampa River. River users can use the trail to access other scenic overlooks. The campsites at Harding Hole are…

activities.name: Healthy Parks, Healthy People
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Fort Scott encourages outdoor exercise to improve health. Get out and walk to help reduce stress, improve brain function, and instill a sense of well-being. Take advantage of a gentle stroll through Fort Scott's beautiful grounds.

activities.name: Bike the Valle Grande Loop
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3-5 Hours)
activities.description: This bike route loops around Valle Grande, providing spectacular views along the entire route.

activities.name: Frederick Douglass NHS Bookstore
activities.description: Operated by America's National Parks, the bookstore sells unique educational products and books related to Frederick Douglass and African American History.

activities.name: Hiking & Exploring Seip Earthworks
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-180 Minutes)
activities.description: Seip Earthworks is a marvel of geometric grandeur that was constructed by the Hopewell culture over 2,000 years ago. Today, visitors can take in the magnitude of the site's scale and the Hopewell accomplishments as you can hike in and around the complex to experience what it may have been like to be part of such an…

activities.name: Walnut Canyon Overlook Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This short 180 yards (165 m) paved walkway provides great views of Walnut Canyon.

activities.name: Hanford: Hike the White Bluffs North Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-4 Hours)
activities.description: On this trail you may explore rolling sand dunes, take in vast vistas dotted with relics of plutonium production during the Manhattan Project and Cold War, and observe a variety of wildlife.

activities.name: West Auto Tour
activities.description: West Auto Tour

activities.name: Fishing at Padre Island National Seashore
activities.description: Cast a line and soak in the day at Padre Island National Seashore.

activities.name: Watch the Coho Salmon Run on Lapwai Creek
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Coho Salmon have used the waterways of North Central Idaho for millennia to travel to and from the Ocean. In 1984 Coho Salmon were listed as an extinct species, but the hard work of the Nez Perce Fisheries Program has brought them back.

activities.name: Discover Bristol Bay Fishing History
activities.description: Explore a sailboat that spent more than 60 years on Bristol Bay waters during the heyday of Alaska's commercial salmon fishery.

activities.name: Sledding & Snowplay in the Southwest Area
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The steep slopes behind the Kohm Yah-mah-nee Visitor Center are a popular destination for sledders. Lassen's deep snowfall also provides ample opportunity for snowplay. Snowman building contest, anyone?

activities.name: Paddle Erbie to Ozark
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3-4 Hours)
activities.description: A serene, 5.4-mile stretch of the Buffalo River winds between Erbie and Ozark and offers excellent opportunities for solitude and wildlife watching.

activities.name: Old North Church: Crypt Tour
activities.basis: estimated from duration (25 Minutes)
activities.description: Take a self-guided tour of Old North’s historic crypt, where 1,100 people were laid to rest.

activities.name: Explore Exhibits on Tlingit Life
activities.description: Learn about Tlingit culture and way of life through historical and contemporary ceremonial objects. Observe demonstrating artists in the wood, regalia, or metalworking studios or outdoors at the carving shed.

activities.name: Experience an Urban Oasis at Greenbelt Park
activities.description: Just ten miles from Washington, D.C., Greenbelt Park is located in suburban Greenbelt, Maryland. The park features a 172 site campground with specific site reservations, nine miles of trails, and three picnic areas. The campground is open all year round.

activities.name: Swim Echo Lake Beach
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Echo Lake Beach is a popular, freshwater swimming area on the southern end of Echo Lake. It is accessible off Route 102 in Southwest Harbor.

activities.name: Ignite your Imagination at Monocacy National Battlefield
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-4 Hours)
activities.description: Monocacy National Battlefield encompasses several centuries of history, which reflect events of both national and local significance.

activities.name: Mountain Top Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Mountaintop trail can be linked with Canyon Trail and West Mountain trail to complete a loop around West Mountain. If hiking southward, the trail is strenuous, as it gains elevation quickly. If hiking northward, there is a steady rise in elevation until you cross Sunset Trail; the trail descends steeply to the…

activities.name: Trail run at Endless Wall
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Endless Wall Trail is and excellent place for a trail run but due to the volume of other hikers, this trail runner would recommend that this be an early morning location. The trail is easy to moderate for elevation change and if you make a loop and run on the road to connect the two parking areas, the loop will be…

activities.name: Walk the Canyon Nature Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Take a walk along the American Fork river on the north side of the canyon. This side of the canyon features wildlife and plants not found on the south side. There are several interpretive signs along the trail and benches to rest on. You can also view the cave entrance roughly 1,000 feet higher and across the canyon…

activities.name: Hike the Kirby Nature Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: 1½ to 2½ miles roundtrip | Experience the Big Thicket on a gentle loop hike through different kinds of forest. See majestic bald cypress trees and knees and Village Creek.

activities.name: Hike the Plug Hat Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: 0.25 miles (0.4 km) round trip loop trail. Easy. The Plug Hat Trail offers scenic views of Dinosaur's rugged landscape from atop a sandstone butte. This trail is paved and wheelchair accessible. Leashed pets are allowed.

activities.name: Walk the Elephant Seal Overlook Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (15-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Follow the short Elephant Seal Overlook Trail to a viewpoint from which elephant seals are usually visible. Allow 45 minutes driving time from Bear Valley to the Chimney Rock Parking Lot.

activities.name: Explore the Exit Glacier area in a couple of hours
activities.description: Would you like to visit the Exit Glacier area, but only have a couple of hours? These are some suggestions for what you might do with that time.

activities.name: Bouldering Near Barker Dam
activities.description: Barker Dam offers a wide range of popular bouldering problems.

activities.name: Hike the Main Pueblo Loop Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-90 Minutes)
activities.description: Summary, things to see, and maps of the famous Pueblo Loop Trail in Bandelier National Monument.

activities.name: Virtual Tours
activities.description: Explore with geologists and their helicopter pilot around Kennicott Glacier on an interactive website virtual tour to learn how National Park Service staff monitor changes in the size of the glacier! Check out the Terrestrial LiDAR Scanning Project with 3-D data collected which provides precise measurements needed for…

activities.name: Bicycles in Pea Ridge National Park
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-120 Minutes)
activities.description: Cycling at Pea Ridge National Military Park is a great way to discover the true scope of the park, both in size and meaning. It is also a wonderful opportunity to experience a quiet peaceful place of nature in bustling Northwest Arkansas.

activities.name: Hike Jesup Path and Hemlock Path Loop
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: This forested path continues to a boardwalk with multiple interpretive signs and benches. It opens up to a meadow before looping back on an old fire road. Views of Dorr Mountain are interspersed in this walk along a birch and hemlock forest.

activities.name: Hike to Spray Falls
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-3 Hours)
activities.description: Enjoy a short hike from Mowich Lake to a large cascading waterfall fed by a glacier.

activities.name: Hike the Little River, Cucumber Gap, Jakes Creek Loop
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Hike 5.4 miles (8.7 km) on a pleasant and shady loop connecting three trails with streamside views, historic structures, and prolific spring wildflower displays. Trail conditions vary from paved road and graveled path to narrower and rockier sections with minor stream crossings.

activities.name: Summit Level Visitor Center bookstore
activities.description: The bookstore at Allegheny Portage Railroad National Historic Site is operated by America's National Parks and is located in the Visitor Center. It contains books about the Allegheny Portage Railroad, t-shirts, coffee mugs, pins, patches, magnets and many other items are available for purchase. Stamps for the Passport…

activities.name: Explore a Civil War Era Fort
activities.description: Explore a Civil War era fort on the west coast!

activities.name: Visit the USS Oklahoma Memorial
activities.description: The USS Oklahoma Memorial stands to honor the 429 men who lost their lives aboard the Oklahoma on December 7th, 1941. These men were not only sailors and Marines, they were 429 brothers, sons, husbands, and fathers.

activities.name: Hike the Deep Creek Waterfalls Loop
activities.description: See three waterfalls on a loop around the Deep Creek area. Hike 2.4 miles (3.9 km) on several short trail segments to reach Juney Whank Falls, Indian Creek Falls, and Tom Branch Falls.

activities.name: Become a Manzanar Junior Ranger
activities.description: At home or at Manzanar, becoming a junior ranger is a great way to learn about the stories of Manzanar.

activities.name: Ski the Cerro La Jara Loop
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: This 1.5-mile (2.4 km) ski loop circles Cerro La Jara, the smallest volcanic dome in the park, which formed about 500,000 years ago when lava oozed up and onto the caldera floor.

activities.name: Hike the Abbotts Lagoon Trail to the Ocean
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Take an easy hike that will lead you past a unique coastal lagoon bordered by sand dunes to the Pacific Ocean. This hike offers great opportunities for viewing birds and wildflowers. Allow 20 to 25 minutes driving time from Bear Valley to the Abbotts Lagoon Trailhead.

activities.name: Swimming
activities.description: Splashing in the surf and bodyboarding are a favorite activity along the beach.

activities.name: Picnic Areas
activities.description: Catoctin Mountain Park offers many places for individuals to sit down and enjoy a meal under the forest canopy.

activities.name: Discover Bird Watching in the Virgin Islands
activities.description: Join our Park Ranger for a tour of Francis Bay Trail and the nearby salt pond. While there you will enjoy to opportunity to view the many resident and migratory birds that call Francis Bay home.

activities.name: Enjoy a Picnic at Scotts Bluff
activities.description: Enjoy a picnic at Scotts Bluff National Monument

activities.name: Mossy Cave Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Mossy Cave trail is one of the lowest elevation hikes in the park as well as one of the only hikes that begins with a climb and ends with a descent. This trail provides access to Water Canyon in one direction and to a sheltered overhang known as Mossy Cave in the other. This area is filled with mosses in the summer…

activities.name: Attend a Ranger-led Program
activities.description: Attending a ranger-led program in the park is a great way to discover new things and learn more about the Mammoth Cave National Park.

activities.name: Hike the Narrows Rim Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-6 Hours)
activities.description: Spectacular panoramic views of the lava flows at El Malpais and surrounding landscape are the main attraction of this hike. You may also encounter ravens and other birds of prey enjoying the thermal uplifts here.

activities.name: Harbor Bay Hiking
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Harbor Bay Trail System consists of two trails: Harbor Bay Trail and the Turkey Creek Trail. Both of these trails are located at Harbor Bay. The trails both have diverse ecosystems and provide views of the lake. The area is full of mesas and canyons on each of the trails. The Turkey Creek Trail winds along the…

activities.name: Fort Larned Visitor Center
activities.description: The Fort Larned Visitor Center is open daily from 8:30 am to 4:30 pm. It is closed on Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day.

activities.name: Sunset Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Sunset Trail is the longest trail in Hot Springs National Park, covering approximately 10 miles one-way. Crossing all types of terrain, the trail makes its way through the most remote areas of the park. This trail is divided into three sections: West Mountain (2.8 miles), Sugarloaf Mountain (2.6 miles), and…

activities.name: Hike to Sculptured Beach
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: An easy to moderate walk on the beach or through coastal scrub and grassland offers some breath-taking ocean views and leads to a rocky shoreline where one can look for intertidal organisms when the tide is very low. Allow 15 to 20 minutes driving time from Bear Valley to the closest trailheads to Sculptured Beach.

activities.name: Old Lodgepole Road Winter Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This old road connects the Lodgepole Visitor Center with the General Sherman Tree. The skiing is easy, except for a steep grade as the trail approaches the General Sherman Tree.

activities.name: Picnic at Anacostia Park
activities.description: Relax and enjoy a picnic at Anacostia Park. The park has plenty of recreation activities to build up your appetite for a nice picnic while enjoying the view of the Anacostia River and downtown D.C. skyline.

activities.name: Hike Oak Flat Trail - South Rim
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This 1.6 mi (2.6 km) trail offers variety to the hiker who would like to explore below the rim without going all the way to the river. The trail is narrow in places and traverses some steep slopes.

activities.name: Hike up Buck Hill
activities.basis: estimated from duration (5-30 Minutes)
activities.description: Hike to the top of Buck Hill, one of the highest points in the park, and get an amazing 360° view of the surrounding badlands!

activities.name: Echo Canyon Loop Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The most impressive moderate hike in the park. Hike 3.3 miles through balancing rocks, the unique tunnel-like grottoes, narrow slots, and below cliffs of towering pinnacles. No pets.

activities.name: Campfire Programs at Gettysburg
activities.description: Rangers present evening campfire talks on a wide variety of topics on the Battle of Gettysburg and the American Civil War. Programs take place at the Pitzer Woods Amphitheater, near Auto Tour Stop #6.

activities.name: Hike the Boyhood Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (10-15 Minutes)
activities.description: Walk along the same ground that Abraham Lincoln did when he was a boy growing into a young man.

activities.name: Old Rag Circuit
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: PARK BOUNDARY | Visitors must obtain an Old Rag day-use ticket in advance of this hike. Pets are not allowed. Old Rag is a popular, very strenuous hike with sweeping views and several scrambles across large rocks. This route starts from the Old Rag parking area on the boundary of the Park.

activities.name: Gateway Arch Wellness Challenge
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Gateway Arch National Park offers you multiple opportunities to improve your health through physical, mental and learning challenges. Will you rest below an architectural wonder and take a moment to breathe? Will you stroll through the paved paths of the Explorer’s Garden? Will you learn something new about history?…

activities.name: Visit the Washington Monument
activities.description: Did you know you can go to the top of the Washington Monument? You can! But you will need to plan ahead. Tickets are required to visit the interior of the Washington Monument.

activities.name: Hike the Box Canyon Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: 0.25 miles (0.4 km) round trip, out and back trail. Easy. The Box Canyon Trail is a relatively level and shady walk into a dead-end canyon. The trailhead is located on the north side of the parking area for the Josie Morris Cabin. This is typically a good hike for small children. Keep kids close, and watch for poison…

activities.name: Visit the Elkhorn Ranch Unit
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3-6 Hours)
activities.description: Visit the location of Theodore Roosevelt's home ranch, the Elkhorn, and experience the solitude of the North Dakota badlands.

activities.name: Watch the Park Orientation Film
activities.description: The 19-minute park orientation film Determined to Persevere: The Valley Forge Encampment is shown daily on the hour and the half-hour in the Meeting Room. The first screening is at 9:30 AM and the final screening is at 4:30 PM.

activities.name: Visit the Lodgepole Visitor Center
activities.description: With brand new museum exhibits, a Park Store, and a wilderness information counter, the Lodgepole Visitor Center is the place to be.

activities.name: Exploring The Battle of Tupelo
activities.description: More than 20,000 Union and Confederate soldiers fought in and around Tupelo, Mississippi between the morning of July 14 and the evening of July 15, 1864. This is known as the Battle of Tupelo or the Battle of Harrisburg.

activities.name: Wildflower Walk at Fort Funston
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Take a walk and enjoy the scenic views of the wildflowers blooming at Fort Funston.

activities.name: See the Rhododendrons Bloom at Craggy Gardens
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-4 Hours)
activities.description: Colorful rhododendron blossoms put on a show each summer along the Blue Ridge Parkway and one of the best places to see these high-elevation flowers is at Craggy Gardens.

activities.name: Hanford: Tour the Pasco Aviation Museum
activities.description: During World War II, Pasco Aviation in Pasco, Washington was one of the three largest training bases for aviators in the United States. Today, it hosts a recently opened and expanded museum that showcases aviation history.

activities.name: Overnight on Wilderness Ridge
activities.description: The lesser used Permian Reef Trail leads to sheltered campsites and spectacular views into McKittrick Canyon, making a great destination of a one night, two day backpacking trip into the Wilderness.

activities.name: Wolverton Winter Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This short trail connects the Old Lodgepole Road with the Wolverton Parking area. This steep hillside route requires considerable control for downhill travel when skiing away from Wolverton.

activities.name: Short Hike to Leleiwi Overlook
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Take a short .3 mile (.5 km) roundtrip walk out to Leleiwi Overlook. Pass native plants on your way to a spectacular view of the crater and the Koʻolau Gap.

activities.name: Red Foxes
activities.description: Red foxes are found throughout the northern hemisphere. In Glacier, they are adapted to a wide range of habitats, from open grasslands to dense forests. Most abundant in riparian areas and along the edges of forests, they are the smallest of the canids found in the park. Red foxes occur in several color phases, but…

activities.name: Take a walk or bike ride on the Mount Vernon Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-4 Hours)
activities.description: The Mount Vernon Trail winds alongside the Potomac River offering uninterrupted views of Washington, D.C.'s skyline. A run, walk, or cycle along the trail leads to all of the same sites that can be reached by car on the parallel section of the parkway.

activities.name: Hike the Sky–Bear Valley Loop
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This varied hike takes you through dense forest, meadows, chaparral, and coastal grasslands, starting with an uphill climb on the east side of Inverness Ridge to a ridgetop with ocean views. Follow the forested ridgeline to the coastline, and return on a mostly flat trail through Bear Valley. This hike starts at the…

activities.name: Ranger Walkabouts
activities.description: During the months of June, July, and August, join a Park Ranger on 60-minute walking tour at varying locations in the Blackstone Valley.

activities.name: Hike North Vista Trail - North Rim
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Constructed by the Volunteers for Outdoor Colorado, the North Vista Trail offers some of the best scenic views and birding in the park. Difficulty varies from moderate to strenuous based on distance.

activities.name: Hiking at Oxon Cove Park
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-120 Minutes)
activities.description: Hiking at Oxon Cove Park

activities.name: Hike the Buffalo Point Campground Trails
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-4 Hours)
activities.description: The Buffalo Point Campground Trails give campers, day hikers, and leashed dogs a chance to stretch their legs between the campground and the historic cabin area at Buffalo Point. Hike through a mix of a pine and oak trees, a cedar glade, and past a sinkhole as you explore. Wildflowers dot the trail system throughout…

activities.name: Paddling The Riverway
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-120 Hours)
activities.description: Paddling the rivers of the St. Croix National Scenic Riverway.

activities.name: Rodeo Lagoon Birdwatching
activities.description: Birdwatching in Rodeo Lagoon

activities.name: Easy: Paddle from Narrowsburg to Ten Mile River
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Paddle this calm stretch of river from Narrowsburg River Access to Ten Mile River Access. This stretch is approximately 6 river miles and takes on average 3 hours to paddle.

activities.name: Bird Watching at Oakland Plantation
activities.description: Cane River Creole provides habitat for a wide variety of birds. Bring your binoculars and enjoy the spectacular views of the many birds in the park.

activities.name: Hike Wall Street Mill
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: A moderate two mile out and back hike to an old mill site.

activities.name: Bearpaw and Trapper Lakes
activities.basis: estimated from duration (4-6 Hours)
activities.description: Hike along the shore of Leigh Lake for panoramic views of Mount Moran.

activities.name: Experience the Huna Tribal House
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-3 Hours)
activities.description: Take a walk on the Łingít trail to see the first permanent clan house in Glacier Bay since Łingít villages were destroyed by an advancing glacier over 250 years ago.

activities.name: Walk the River Loop Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: The trail is open year round. No access to the river. No water or restrooms are located along the trail.

activities.name: The Big Loop
activities.basis: estimated from duration (4-7 Hours)
activities.description: For folks wanting to do everything, this 9.5 mile route consists of the Echo Canyon, Upper Rhyolite Canyon, Sarah Deming, Heart of Rocks, Big Balanced Rock, Inspiration Point, Mushroom Rock, and Ed Riggs trails. It features our balanced rocks. The trail begins from the Echo Canyon trailhead.

activities.name: Lonely Dell Ranch Historic Site
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Hidden between the shade of trees near the muddy Paria River sits Lonely Dell Ranch. This historic site was once home to those who operated the river crossing at Lees Ferry. Life was challenging on the homestead, but the families who chose to live on this secluded outpost left behind a story of hard work and…

activities.name: Walk Cable Mill Area Trails
activities.description: Visit the Cable Mill area for a glimpse into a traditional Appalachian farming community.

activities.name: Enjoy the River Raisin Heritage Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The River Raisin Heritage Trail The Heritage Trail has eight miles of paved hike-bike trails that provide safe and scenic routes to walk, run, cycle and in-line skate. The trail connects major historic sites, state and local parks, nationally significant buildings and ecological features. Parking areas and facilities…

activities.name: Watch the Sunset from Desert View Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Searching for that quintessential desert sunset? The Desert View trail has your back! This short, 1.2 mile (1.9 km) can be reached from Twin Peaks Campground and loops around striking stands of organ pipe cacti. The Desert View trail offers great views for sunrise or sunset.

activities.name: Visit Coronado Visitor Center
activities.description: Explore the exhibits about the Coronado Expedition, the legacy of Spanish and Native American cultures in the region, and the natural history of Coronado National Memorial.

activities.name: Scotts Bluff Ranger Programs
activities.description: Learn more about Scotts Bluff National Monument by attending a ranger-guided program!

activities.name: Look for Migrating Monarch Butterflies
activities.description: Among the fall wildflowers, and drifting on invisible wind currents high above you, look for the jewel tones of monarch butterflies as the insects pass through the parkway's high elevations on their seasonal migration.

activities.name: Heritage Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: A paved trail that is a favorite for bikers.

activities.name: Oertel Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: From downtown, ascend the Stephen's Balustrade (grand staircase) behind the Fordyce Visitor Center to the Grand Promenade and climb the next two sets of steps until you reach the gravel road. Take the road right until you reach an iron gate; the trailhead begins here. Oertel Trail ranges from moderate to very steep…

activities.name: Hanford: Watch Hanford Made
activities.description: Watch the Hanford Site film at the Manhattan Project NHP Visitor Center for a general introduction to the Manhattan Project and Hanford’s role as the plutonium production site for the project.

activities.name: Hensley Settlement Tours
activities.description: Guided Tours of Hensley Settlement

activities.name: March with the Missouri State Guard
activities.basis: estimated from duration (25-90 Minutes)
activities.description: Follow in the footsteps of Missouri State Guard soldiers! Cross Wilson's Creek on a historic bridge and peek into a cabin near where Major General Sterling Price set up his headquarters. Continue the adventure at Bloody Hill, the battlefield's most iconic location.

activities.name: Paddle Tobin Harbor
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3-6 Hours)
activities.description: Embark on a serene paddle in Tobin Harbor, on the east end of Isle Royale National Park. Wildlife sightings, especially aquatic birds, are abound in this scenic harbor.

activities.name: Full Day Expeditions
activities.description: Whether you have an hour, a half day, or a full day, the beaches, dunes, and trails of Indiana Dunes offer relaxation, inspiration, and fun adventures. This list highlights some of the must-see sights in the park. This is perfect for people planning a day full of activities and possibly an overnight.

activities.name: Arlington Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (5-10 Minutes)
activities.description: Ask for directions to the trailhead from staff at the Arlington Hotel lobby. Arlington Trail will connect with Lower Dogwood Trail.

activities.name: Trail use at Chamizal National Memorial
activities.description: Chamizal National Memorial provides a Zen place to reflect on conflict and resolution. The trails compliment the memorial, giving the public the ability to use them in multiple ways.

activities.name: Tufa Terrace Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This paved trail can be reached from the Grand Promenade or Arlington Lawn. The lower portion of the Tufa Terrace Trail is near the Hot Water Cascade.

activities.name: Bike Redwoods to Beach on the Ossagon Trail Loop
activities.description: Follow a 19-mile loop through old-growth redwood forests to the Pacific coast and back. The route combines Ossagon Trail, Coastal Trail (Gold Beach Section), Davison Road and Newton B. Drury Scenic Parkway.

activities.name: Hike the Great Island Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3-4 Hours)
activities.description: Are you looking for a day of adventure? Look no further than Cape Cod National Seashore's longest hiking trail, Great Island! Make your own adventure to enjoy the shorter 3.9-mile loop or go for gold with the full 8.8 mile loop to Jeremy Point!

activities.name: Watch "Another Such Victory"
activities.description: This live-action theater film explores the historical personal accounts of American and British soldiers involved in the battle, as well as the Quakers and civilians caught in the after effects.

activities.name: Walk the Kule Loklo Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (20-60 Minutes)
activities.description: A short path leads up to a replica of a Coast Miwok Indian village. Interpretive signs briefly describe Coast Miwok culture and history and the structures in the village. This trail begins at the north end of the Bear Valley parking lot.

activities.name: Massai Point Nature Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30 Minutes)
activities.description: A half-mile loop trail through balanced rocks starts at the top of the scenic drive, Massai Point parking area.

activities.name: Explore Exhibits on Booker T. Washington’s Early Life
activities.description: The Booker T. Washington Visitor Center features an exhibit providing an in-depth examination of life on a small tobacco plantation in Piedmont, Virginia. Two large circular displays help you experience what life was like for Booker T. Washington, who was born into enslavement in 1856, during the years leading up to…

activities.name: Amache Self-Guided Driving Tour
activities.description: Amache Preservation Society has created a self-driving audio tour that leads visitors to 11 points of interest at the historic site.

activities.name: Take a Stroll Behind Quarters 1
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Take a walk behind Quarters 1 to escape the urban center and reconnect with nature! Behind Quarters 1 there is a large grassy lawn where one can sit and relax and look out over the City of Springfield. The Armory Victory Garden is also located beside Quarters 1; take a look at our garden and all the vegetables and…

activities.name: General Grant National Memorial Junior Ranger Program
activities.description: Participate in the Junior Ranger program at General Grant National Memorial, and learn about General Grant, his final resting place, and the National Park Service.

activities.name: Hike to Shriner Peak Fire Lookout
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Embark on a strenuous hike up to a historic fire lookout with adjacent backcountry camping sites and enjoy views of Mount Rainier and the surrounding valley.

activities.name: Slaughter Canyon Cave Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (90 Minutes)
activities.description: A scenic 0.5 mile (1 km) hike that leads to viewpoints overlooking Slaughter Canyon.

activities.name: Birding Seawall
activities.description: Seawall provides great birding opportunities on the west side of Mount Desert Island at Acadia National Park.

activities.name: Los Alamos: Visit the Los Alamos History Museum Campus
activities.description: Nestled in downtown Los Alamos, the Los Alamos History Museum presents the stories of this secret city from multiple perspectives via indoor and outdoor venues, historic buildings, artifacts, documents, photographs, audio and video recordings of personal stories, and interactive visitor experiences.

activities.name: Hanford: Visit the Franklin County Historical Museum
activities.description: The Franklin County Historical Society has artifacts, educational programs, and displays that share story of the development of Franklin County. The museum building was originally constructed in 1910 as part of Andrew Carnegie’s worldwide library construction program.

activities.name: Rim Walk with a Ranger
activities.basis: estimated from duration (45-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Typically offered Memorial Day through Labor Day at Sunset Point at 2:00 p.m. Join a Ranger and experience the enchantment of the hoodoos, the history of the people who have passed through the amphitheaters for thousands of years, and the many ways the animals and plants have adapted to the unique ecosystems of Bryce…

activities.name: Drive CO Highway 92
activities.description: Colorado (CO) Highway 92 crosses over Blue Mesa Dam and winds along the north rim of the Black Canyon, providing access to scenic overlooks and trailheads.

activities.name: Ask a Ranger: French Quarter
activities.description: Curious about the French Quarter or New Orleans history? Ask a Ranger!

activities.name: Visit the Springfield Armory Museum
activities.description: Visit the Springfield Armory Museum located in the Main Arsenal (Building 13). The Museum tells the story of the workers and details the technological innovations of firearms, the mechanization and specialization in precision manufacturing, and the production of small arms that occurred at the Armory. The Museum shows…

activities.name: Flood of Fire Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Mostly easy with several stair steps, this 0.5 mi (0.8 km) long trail ends at a dramatic cliff face and a view of colorful geologic formations and fiery floods of basalt across the valley.

activities.name: Snorkeling Nearby
activities.description: The clear blue waters of Hōnaunau Bay hold spectacular wonders of the underwater world. Spinner dolphins with their amazing acrobatics frequent the bay, eels and octopus lurk in the cracks and crevices of the reef, and a colorful variety of fish flourish among the corals. Come explore the depths at "Two Step," located…

activities.name: Bike the Cowboy Trail
activities.basis:
estimated from duration (Visitors can spend as much time as they prefer on the Cowboy Trail. 

Biking to the historic railroad bridge from the Valentine City Park Trailhead is 2.5 miles, one way.

Walking out and back to the historic railroad bridge from the Highway 20 Trailhead and parking lot can take about an hour, but can be done in much shorter time as well. The distance to the bridge from that trailhead is 0.75 miles.)
activities.duration:
Visitors can spend as much time as they prefer on the Cowboy Trail. 

Biking to the historic railroad bridge from the Valentine City Park Trailhead is 2.5 miles, one way.

Walking out and back to the historic railroad bridge from the Highway 20 Trailhead and parking lot can take about an hour, but can be done in much shorter time as well. The distance to the bridge from that trailhead is 0.75 miles.
activities.description: The Cowboy Trail is a hiking and biking trail created from the historic bed of the railroad track that passed through Valentine, NE, and the Sandhills. Many hikers and bikers covet the views of the Niobrara National Scenic River from the 148 foot historic bridge, not far from Valentine.

activities.name: Take a Selfie with Orville and Wilbur
activities.description: Visit the sculpture recreating the events of December 17, 1903 and the first, manned, powered, heavier-than-air flight here in Kitty Hawk, NC.

activities.name: Visit Glen Haven Historic Village
activities.description: Glen Haven is the best-preserved cord wood station on the eastern shore of Lake Michigan, and perhaps in the entire Great Lakes. It was a company town, eventually diversifying into farming, canning of fruit, and tourism. Today, the history of Glen Haven is still preserved within several buildings that you can visit…

activities.name: Explore the Museum
activities.description: Access to the museum is available to all visitors on Liberty Island.

activities.name: Watch an Artillery Demonstration at Fort Washington Park
activities.description: Ever wonder how Civil War cannons were fired? Visit the park the first Sunday of every month from May to November to watch the Fort Washington Guard demonstrate and explain the procedures used during the muzzle-loading era of American Artillery.

activities.name: Hike to the Swelter Shelter Petroglyphs
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: 400 feet (122 m) out and back trail. Easy. This short hike to Swelter Shelter offers visitors an opportunity to view a variety of petroglyphs and pictographs very close to the road. Petroglyphs and pictographs are fragile, irreplaceable records of the past that many still hold sacred. Don't touch, trace, or take…

activities.name: Feldtmann Loop Section 1: Hike from Windigo to Feldtmann Lake
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1 Day)
activities.description: Hike on the Feldtmann Lake Trail and experience remnants of an old Lake Superior shoreline. Mileage: About 8.5 miles

activities.name: Float the Niobrara River
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-8 Hours)
activities.description: Experience the beauty of the Niobrara National Scenic River up close and personal by floating the gentle waters through six ecosystems, past waterfalls, and under historic bridges. A gem in the Sandhills of the Great Plains.

activities.name: Drive the Echo Park Road
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The 14 mile (23 km) unpaved Echo Park Road takes drivers into the heart of Dinosaur National Monument. This rugged road begins along the Harpers Corner Road, winds through scenic canyon country, and ends near the banks of the Green River at Echo Park. High-clearance vehicles with all-wheel-drive (AWD) are strongly…

activities.name: Sunset Rock Winter Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This easy trail leads through a mixed-conifer forest of red firs, Jeffrey pines, sugar pines, and incense cedars to a large granite dome. Once there, take a seat on the dome and enjoy the sweeping views of a deep canyon that was carved by the Kaweah River. If you're there for sunset, sit back and enjoy the colorful…

activities.name: Fishing at Star Fort Pond
activities.description: Fishing at Ninety Six can be both relaxing and rewarding. Learn were to park and the rules and regulations before casting your line.

activities.name: Kayak or Canoe Core Sound and Back Sound
activities.duration: Total time varies depending on float plan, skill level, and weather conditions. Please plan accordingly.
activities.description: The islands of this North Carolina park lie between two and three miles from the mainland. At this distance, even novice paddlers can cross the open waters of Core Sound and Back Sound under good conditions. While everyone can enjoy exploring the marshes and shallow waters of the sounds, the more ambitious kayakers…

activities.name: Hike the Rush Mine Level Trail and Morning Star Interpretive Loop
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-4 Hours)
activities.description: This .25 mile to 1.5 mile trail offers beautiful views of Rush Valley and gives hikers an understanding of the historic, mining, landscape. In the 1880s, zinc ore was discovered in the hills and claims were staked out along Rush Valley and neighboring Clabber Creek. Eventually, a community of homes and businesses…

activities.name: Eat Lunch at Aztec Ruin's Picnic Area
activities.description: Enjoy a picnic in the shade.

activities.name: Visit Resaca de la Palma Battlefield
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-120 Minutes)
activities.description: Resaca de la Palma Battlefield features a half-mile circular trail with interpretive waysides. Head out to the observation deck on the resaca and experience why resacas make Brownsville, TX such a special place.

activities.name: Visit the Spatter Cones
activities.basis: estimated from duration (10-15 Minutes)
activities.description: Take a short walk to view some of the park's mini-volcanoes up close and personal.

activities.name: Hike Great Head Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-4 Hours)
activities.description: This 1.7 mile trail has spectacular ocean views along a coastal headland with some wooded sections. This historic trail also includes the ruins of an early 1900's tea house.

activities.name: Go on a Day Hike at Coldwater Spring
activities.description: Enjoy a nice day hike and many opportunities for wildlife viewing, photography, and reflection at Coldwater Spring! Trails surround a restored prairie oak savannah and wetlands in this culturally and historically significant gem that is open year-round.

activities.name: Bonita Creek Loop
activities.basis: estimated from duration (15-30 Minutes)
activities.description: This Bonita Creek loops around the picnic area and takes you along the intermittent Bonita Creek. Watch for Apache plume and prickly poppy flowers in spring and early summer. Arizona whitetail deer are frequently seen in the lower portion of Bonita Canyon. This is a good trail to view grassland birds.

activities.name: Watch for Salmon
activities.description: Salmon are easily observed from the bridge over Indian River when they spawn each summer and fall. Strong ties bind them to the people, plants, and animals of Sitka.

activities.name: James River Batteau Company
activities.description: Step aboard a hand-built replica of a James River Batteau and explore the history of Virginia’s rivers. Guided cruises include stories of the boatmen who carried goods and culture along the James, complimentary charcuterie and live music, and immerse you in life along the river. This Chesapeake Gateways Network…

activities.name: Birdwatching at Spring Canyon
activities.description: This area was specifically built for birding in the wetlands.

activities.name: Los Alamos: Join a Ranger Program
activities.description: Los Alamos ranger programs are a great way to explore the remarkable history of the Manhattan Project. Call 505-661-6277 to see what ranger programs are available during your visit.

activities.name: Swimming at Pictured Rocks
activities.description: Pictured Rocks has several beautiful beach areas for swimming and wading in Lake Superior. Two of the park's inland lakes have sandy bottom areas suitable for swimming. There are no lifeguarded beaches.

activities.name: Boundary Oak Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Boundary Oak trail is an a short easy trail that leads from the Boundary Oak marker to the Memorial Building.

activities.name: North Grove Loop Winter Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-3 Hours)
activities.description: The North Grove Loop travels through a magnificent grove of giant sequoias. Skiers will find it easier to follow this loop trail counterclockwise to avoid some of the sharper downhill curves in the road.

activities.name: Hiking the Ice Age Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This level, family-friendly trail interprets the Ice Age history of the Tularosa Basin

activities.name: Stop by the Fort Donelson NB Visitor Center
activities.description: Visitor Center

activities.name: Camp at Kontrashibuna Lake
activities.description: Pack up and journey out to the wilderness. Lay in your tent listening to a lone wolf's howl. Stand in awe as mountains reflect across still waters in the early morning light.

activities.name: Hike to the Wheeler Peak Bristlecone Grove
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-3 Hours)
activities.description: The Bristlecone Trail is not to be missed on a visit to the park. This 2.8-mile round-trip hike takes visitors through some of the oldest organisms on Earth, and offers opportunities for introspection as you consider your place in the universe.

activities.name: Drive the Red Route of the Yorktown Battlefield Auto Tour
activities.description: Open year round until sunset, the Yorktown Battlefield Red Route Auto Tour is a 7 mile drive that takes visitors to the most important spots on the Yorktown Battlefield. Allow at least 45 minute to complete this tour. There are information waysides at each of the stops and along the route.

activities.name: Boat on Morrow Point Reservoir
activities.description: For the more adventurous, Morrow Point Reservoir is a great location for canoeing or kayaking. The easiest access to launch hand-carried craft is via the Pine Creek Trail.

activities.name: Shop at the Park Store
activities.description: The park store is operated by Western National Parks Association, an official non-profit partner of the National Park Service dedicated to supporting the educational mission of Guadalupe Mountains National Park. The park store has a wide range of books, maps, travel guides, and other items available for retail sale…

activities.name: Hike to Suzy's Cave
