activities.name: Walk Blue Mesa Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This 1-mile alternately paved and gravel trail loop offers the unique experience of hiking among banded badland hills of bentonite clay as well as petrified wood.

activities.name: Biking at Shark Valley
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-6 Hours)
activities.description: Explore the everglades by biking the 15-mile (24 km) Shark Valley Tram Road. Along the way you can experience the wide array of wildlife, diverse freshwater ecosystems, and get a unique view of the Everglades!

activities.name: Hike The Mount Finlayson Loop Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: This popular trail is a 2.9 mile loop. It visits numerous ecosystems and provides excellent views of the Cascades and Olympic Mountains.

activities.name: Rappahannock Adventures
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-7 Hours)
activities.description: Rappahannock Adventures offers guided paddling, fishing, birding, hiking, and biking experiences on Virginia's Middle Peninsula. Visitors explore the Rappahannock River and surrounding landscapes while learning about Indigenous history, wildlife, watershed ecology, conservation, and the cultural heritage of the…

activities.name: Tenement Museum Tours
activities.description: The guided tours currently offered by the Lower East Side Tenement Museum.

activities.name: Bear Hill Winter Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The trail follows the old Bear Hill Road and travels under the shade of giant sequoias and mixed conifers. Bear Hill Road is wide and easy to follow with a moderate grade.

activities.name: Hike The Chilkoot Trail With Your Dog
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-7 Days)
activities.description: The Chilkoot Trail is a 33-mile recreational hiking trail spanning from coastal Alaska to boreal British Columbia. Each summer over 3,000 people retrace the route of gold seekers by hiking this trail. Find out how to plan the best trip along this trail if you are taking your dog.

activities.name: Timber Creek Overlook
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Follows a ridge to views of Timber Creek, Kolob Terrace, and the Pine Valley Mountains.

activities.name: Tour Fort Union Trading Post
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-120 Minutes)
activities.description: Tour through history as you explore Fort Union Trading Post NHS. .

activities.name: Hike Sieur de Monts to Jesup Path with Island Explorer Bus
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: The trails from Sieur de Monts to Jesup Path are located adjacent to the Nature Center and the Wild Gardens of Acadia in a wooded area.

activities.name: Oak Ridge: Visit the K-25 History Center
activities.description: The K-25 History Center tells the story of the K-25 complex from its inception during the Manhattan Project through the Cold War. Follow the link for more information on exhibits and operating hours at this free museum.

activities.name: Exploring the Taft Education Center
activities.description: Start your trip to the park here, the Taft Education Center. It serves as the park's only visitor center and offers many options for guests to begin their journey at the site dedicated to the legacy of William Howard Taft.

activities.name: Take a Short Hike to Buena Vista Peak
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Would you like to hike, but don’t have a lot of time? Head to Buena Vista Peak, which is only a 1-mile hike to a spectacular viewpoint. You’ll be rewarded with views of Redwood Canyon and the Kings Canyon high country.

activities.name: Highway 62/180 to the Guadalupes
activities.description: Every visitor to Guadalupe Mountains National Park travels U.S Highway 62/180. Connecting El Paso, Texas to Carlsbad, New Mexico, the highway provides breath-taking views of the park from the north, south, and west. The highway enters the park for five miles and a series of access roads provide access to park features.

activities.name: Ride to the Top of Hot Springs Mountain Tower
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: 216 feet above Hot Springs Mountain and 1,256 feet above Sea level is the breathtaking panoramic view of the park and its surrounding countryside. Originally being made of wood in 1877, the tower was rebuilt with steel and an elevator in 1982 with both open and enclosed observation decks.

activities.name: Visit Broadhearth Visitor Center
activities.description: Located within the Iron Works House annex, Broadhearth serves as the park visitor center. Books and souvenirs can be purchased inside at the Saugus Iron Works National Historic Site Park Store.

activities.name: Paddle Village Creek
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-6 Hours)
activities.description: Whether you want to go 2.1 miles or 21 miles, Village Creek is a great place for a paddle trip. Tall trees along the creek provide shade and white sand beaches invite paddlers to stop and relax for awhile.

activities.name: Stop by the Glacier Bay Visitor Center
activities.description: Stop by the Glacier Bay Visitor Center to watch a program, join a ranger on a walk, or just explore the exhibits yourself. There's plenty to learn for visitors of all ages.

activities.name: Cinnamon Bay Trails
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Meander through the ruins of the historic Cinnamon Bay Sugar Plantation. Smell the scent of the leaves from the bay rum trees, which were once used to make the famous St John Bay Rum Cologne. The boardwalk and nature loop are located across the road from the entrance to the Cinnamon Bay Campground. The nature loop is…

activities.name: Hike the South Valle Grande Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: The South Valle Grande Trail is a 2-mile round-trip hike that descends to the edge of Valle Grande, offering excellent wildlife viewing opportunities. The hike takes 1-2 hours. Leashed pets are permitted.

activities.name: Birdwatching - Brown's Farm Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: Birds can be observed throughout the entire park, but the secluded nature of the west side makes it ideal for birdwatching.

activities.name: Visit the Hot Water Cascade
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Located at Arlington Lawn, this is the largest visible spring in the Park. Hot water emanates from the hill side near the Grand Promenade and flows under the path, down a steep cliff into two pools.

activities.name: Bicycling at New River Gorge
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: New River Gorge National River offers over fifty miles of mountain bike trails, varying from easy to difficult in terrain and distance.

activities.name: Old North Church: Balcony Tours
activities.description: Visit Old North Church's gallery through a variety of special themed tours.

activities.name: Stamp Your Park Passport
activities.description: Little Rock Central High School NHS has several stamps related to the Passport to Your National Parks program. These stamps help you record your visit and preserve memories from your unique experience at this National Historic Site.

activities.name: Hike Uplands Trail - South Rim
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This .9-mile (1.4 km) trail links the Rim Rock Trail (near the campground) to the upper Oak Flat Loop Trail near the South Rim Visitor Center.

activities.name: Stargaze at Panorama Point
activities.description: Arches National Park and the surrounding Colorado Plateau offer some of the darkest night skies remaining in the United States. You can enjoy the park after dark by viewing spectacular night skies.

activities.name: Stamp Your Passport During Your Visit
activities.description: The Grand Portage National Monument passport stamp is located at the Heritage Center desk.

activities.name: Bike the Redondo Foothills Loop
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Redondo Foothills Loop is a moderately strenuous, 9.5-mile bike route beginning in the Cabin District. This ride features flowy descents, 771 feet of climbing, and great views of Valle Grande.

activities.name: B.A.R.K. Ranger Program
activities.basis: estimated from duration (0-90 Minutes)
activities.description: Do you and your furry friend enjoy visiting Moores Creek National Battlefield? Then why not consider having your friend become an honorary B.A.R.K. Ranger! Stop by the Visitor Center and pick up the B.A.R.K. Ranger brochure and complete the steps on the brochure. Once you have completed all of the steps on the card…

activities.name: Fox Hollow Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1 Hour)
activities.description: Dickey Ridge Visitor Center (Mile 4.6) | Pets are not allowed on this hike. Discover the cultural history of Shenandoah National Park as you pass by historic rock walls, a cemetery, and periwinkles planted by former residents. This hike is also a designated TRACK Trail, featuring a self-guided brochure designed for…

activities.name: Listen to the Lion's Storyteller Audio Tour
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-90 Minutes)
activities.description: Audio Tour at Kingsley Plantation

activities.name: Martin Van Buren Junior Ranger Program
activities.description: Participate in Martin Van Buren National Historic Site's Junior Ranger Program! Our unique Junior Ranger Book offers students of history an engaging way to explore Martin Van Buren's house and grounds.

activities.name: Pay Homage - The Andrew Johnson National Cemetery
activities.description: About the National Cemetery

activities.name: Hike the Muddy Hollow Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This out-and-back trail offers an easy hike with opportunities to see diverse bird life, wildflowers, and possibly tule elk! Allow 15 minutes driving time from Bear Valley to the Muddy Hollow Trailhead and 20 minutes to Limantour Beach.

activities.name: Limberlost
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Limberlost Parking Area (mile 43) | An ADA accessible path through the forest with mountain laurel in the springtime and an example of a columnar jointing geological feature. This hike is also a designated TRACK Trail, featuring a self-guided brochure designed for kids.

activities.name: Birding Along the Blackstone
activities.description: Start your summer weekend off with a bird walk along the beautiful Blackstone River and Canal. Park staff will lead hour-long walking tours at the Blackstone River State Park on Fridays and Sundays. These birding programs are meant for birders of all ages and skill levels. Field guides, binoculars, and Junior Birder…

activities.name: Forks of Cascade Canyon
activities.basis: estimated from duration (5-9 Hours)
activities.description: Travel deep into the Teton Range on this hike through Cascade Canyon.

activities.name: Historic Weapons Demonstrations
activities.description: Black powder weapons demonstrations are given daily throughout the summer at Fort Necessity as staffing permits.

activities.name: Hike the Serviceberry Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The 3.2 mile Serviceberry Loop is a wonderful loop trail through serviceberry, rabbitbrush, and sagebrush, giving plentiful views of unique Great Basin geology. This moderate trail is a great introduction to the Snake Creek area and its unique offerings.

activities.name: Cundick Ridge Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: This unmaintained trail is 2 miles (3.2 km) round trip along an old dirt road. The trail follows Cundick Ridge to an overlook which provides an excellent view of the valley below. On clear days it is possible to see the Uinta Mountains in the distance.

activities.name: Picnic at Kenilworth
activities.description: Relax and enjoy a picnic at Kenilworth Park! Continue the tradition of having a picnic breakfast or lunch that has been enjoyed by visitors to Kenilworth since the early 1900s. President Wilson and his wife Edith would enjoy picnics at the gardens, and you can too!

activities.name: Explore Manzanar Block 14 Exhibits
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Walk through one of the 36 Blocks of Manzanar to feel what life would have been like here during WWII.

activities.name: San Juan Island Junior Ranger Program
activities.description: Junior Ranger programs are a great way for people of all ages to explore multiple facets of the park

activities.name: Travel the Pathway of a President
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Pathway of a President is an accessible wooden boardwalk that leads from the Visitor Center to the Memorial Building.

activities.name: Presidio Birdwatching
activities.description: Birdwatching in the Presidio.

activities.name: Hike Sand Creek Lakes
activities.basis: estimated from duration (10-15 Hours)
activities.description: Sand Creek Lakes are part of the alpine watershed of Great Sand Dunes National Preserve. A longer drive and hike is required to reach these lakes, but the mountain scenery is worth the effort. Check with a ranger for conditions before travel. Snow may block these trails from November into June.

activities.name: Visit Kahuku: Palm Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Hike or bike to some of the best views of Kahuku and along the fissure of the 1868 Mauna Loa eruption

activities.name: Hike Ryan Mountain
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: A popular, steep, three mile out and back hike with wide panoramic views.

activities.name: Hike the Highland Route
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Days)
activities.description: Highland Route

activities.name: Hiking & Exploring Hopewell Mound Group
activities.basis: estimated from duration (45-180 Minutes)
activities.description: The home to the largest Hopewell mound ever constructed and the type-site of the Hopewell culture, Hopewell Mound Group offers visitors a glimpse into the past by showcasing the vastness and size of what these ancient people accomplished. Visitors can learn about the past while enjoying limited recreational…

activities.name: Mountain Biking at Lake Meredith
activities.description: Biking Trails at Lake Meredith in the Harbor Bay Area

activities.name: Visit Kelso Depot
activities.description: Kelso Depot Visitor Center and Museum contains a wealth of information on the human and natural history of the area. Come learn about the plants, animals, and people who have called this area home at some point in history. Rangers are available to answer questions and distribute maps. There is an auditorium featuring…

activities.name: Discover Frederick Douglass’s Home
activities.description: Explore the home of Frederick Douglass, a leading voice in the abolitionist movement.

activities.name: Manzanita Spring
activities.basis: estimated from duration (20-30 Minutes)
activities.description: The Manzanita Spring Trail is a 0.5 mile (0.8 km) out and back trail that begins adjacent the Frijole Ranch. Manzanita Spring is a wide pool that provides excellent bird watching opportunities.

activities.name: Sunset Point to Sunrise Point Hike
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Rim Trail hike meanders along the rim of the iconic Bryce Canyon Amphitheater, giving you views of the hoodoos below. This portion of the Rim Trail, from Sunset Point to Sunrise Point, is the only paved section of this trail and is the easiest walk in the park. Pets are allowed on this trail but must remain on…

activities.name: Hike to Mount Le Conte on the Appalachian Trail and Boulevard Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The longest of the five routes to Mount Le Conte, this strenuous hike—16.2 miles (26.1 km) roundtrip—offers a variety of views and includes part of the Appalachian Trail. Charlies Bunion, a rocky outcrop, is a short but rewarding detour.

activities.name: Hike the Mitchell Hill Easy Loop
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Mitchell Hill Easy Loop follows the Inner Loop Road trail - a picturesque journey through the lush landscapes at English Camp.

activities.name: Paddling Grinder's Ferry to Gilbert
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Either Tyler Bend to Gilbert or Grinder's Ferry to Gilbert can be a pleasant, easy float with plenty of sand/gravel bars to rest and have a picnic. Numerous deep pools provide options for swimming. Weekdays are quiet and peaceful. Weekends are busy and noisy with lots of floaters enjoying the river.

activities.name: A Day In Sunrise
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-8 Hours)
activities.description: If you are looking for great views of Mount Rainier, stunning wildflower meadows, interesting history, or a chance to see wildlife, look no further than Sunrise! Use this guide to help plan your day in Sunrise and explore all this part of Mount Rainier National Park has to offer.

activities.name: Oak Ridge: Explore Haw Ridge Park
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-6 Hours)
activities.description: Haw Ridge Park in Oak Ridge, Tennessee encompasses 780 acres and offers hiking, biking, jogging, and watersports opportunities. Follow the link for more information on available recreational activities.

activities.name: Los Alamos: Learn about Nature on the Pajarito Plateau
activities.description: A visit to the Los Alamos Nature Center gives you the chance to learn more about the incredible wildlife and natural history in this area.

activities.name: Hike the Pitcher Plant Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: 1 mile roundtrip | Follow an easy loop that leads to a boardwalk through a pitcher plant bog where you can look for carnivorous plants in spring and summer.

activities.name: Go Birding At Kenilworth Park and Aquatic Gardens!
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-4 Hours)
activities.description: Open year-round, Kenilworth Park and Aquatic Gardens offers an excellent opportunity for birdwatching. The river, marshes, and hardwood trees offers a diverse habitat for finding birds. Over 240 birds have been sighted at the park!

activities.name: Photography In Yellowstone
activities.duration: Remember to add travel time to your destination.
activities.description: People travel from around the world to take pictures in Yellowstone. Where else can you witness the birth of a bison calf, see a grizzly bear steal a kill from a wolf, or watch the sun set behind an erupting geyser?

activities.name: Overall Run Falls
activities.basis: estimated from duration (4-5 Hours)
activities.description: MILE 22.2 | A hike into federally designated Wilderness to a view of the highest waterfall in the Park at 93 feet. Unless rain is plentiful, Overall Run Falls may have minimal to no water flow.

activities.name: Harbor to Hills Section 1: Hike from Rock Harbor to Three Mile
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1 Day)
activities.description: The Rock Harbor Trail hugs the Rock Harbor Channel offering scenic views of the outer islands. Mileage: About 3.6 miles

activities.name: Hike Zig Zag Loop
activities.basis: estimated from duration (Allow 3 hours for this loop)
activities.description: Walk along flowing Prairie Creek before ascending to ridgetop views in Prairie Creek State Park.

activities.name: Cornfield Mound Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (5-10 Minutes)
activities.description: A short, grassy trail connecting the Earth Lodge to the Heritage Trail.

activities.name: Hike the Mountain View Nature Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (5-30 Minutes)
activities.description: Take a short walk on the Mountain View Nature Trail behind the Lehman Caves Visitor Center. Waiting for a tour? Only wanting a short distance? This nature trail will enlighten you on the past, present, and future of Lehman Caves and Great Basin National Park.

activities.name: Explore L'Hermitage
activities.basis: estimated from duration (20-120 Minutes)
activities.description: Explore the late 18th century slave plantation known as L'Hermitage.

activities.name: Satwiwa Loop Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: This area was set aside for the preservation and celebration of Native American cultures.

activities.name: Drive the Harpers Corner Road
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Harpers Corner Scenic Drive is a 31 mile (50 km) paved road that offers wheelchair-accessible overlooks with spectacular views of Dinosaur's rivers and canyons. Along the way, visitors can enjoy picnic areas, as well as several paved paths and hiking trails. The road is accessible for most vehicles when clear of ice…

activities.name: Collect all the National Capital Parks - East Passport Stamps
activities.place: ANAC, BAWA, CAHI, CAWO, CWDW, FODU, FOFO, FOWA, FRDO, GREE, HAHA, KEAQ, MAMC, NACE, OXHI, PISC
activities.description: Start your stamp collection and celebrate every park you visit! Explore historic sites and scenic parks managed by National Capital Parks - East and collect a unique stamp at each one.

activities.name: Shop at the Boyhood Home Bookstore
activities.description: Support your National Parks by shopping at Eastern National Bookstores, located at the Boyhood Home Unit.

activities.name: Bryce Canyon Evening Program
activities.description: Evening programs, typically offered from Memorial Day through Labor Day, offer topics that go beyond the rim! Check the calendar for daily times and locations. This is a Ranger’s Choice program offering an exploration into compelling stories, interesting themes, and unique resources that make Bryce Canyon special.

activities.name: Old Faithful Lower General Store to Morning Glory Pool Bike Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The paved trail in front of Old Faithful Lodge runs all the way to Morning Glory Pool. Take this short, (2 mi. round-trip) fairly level, paved-path and make stops to see geysers.

activities.name: Hike the Indios Creek Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-4 Hours)
activities.description: The Indios Creek Trail is a 7.8-mile round-trip hike that follows a creek to the northern boundary of the park. It takes about 4 hours to complete. Pets are not permitted.

activities.name: Enjoy Sunrise at the Afton Overlook
activities.description: The Afton Overlook provides an excellent introduction to the Blue Ridge Parkway. The view is spectacular at any time, but the colorful skies produced at sunrise can be truly breathtaking. And remember: No two sunrises are the same. So if you can, plan a few return visits to this unique overlook.

activities.name: Tule Elk Viewing At Point Reyes National Seashore
activities.description: Locations and suggestions for spotting the herds of tule elk that call Point Reyes home.

activities.name: Hike Officer's Hill
activities.description: The trails surrounding the Officers’ Quarters at English Camp offer a captivating journey through history and nature.

activities.name: Take a Cave Tour
activities.description: Visit one of the world's longest and most complex caves.

activities.name: Whale watch from Muir Beach Overlook
activities.description: Whale Watch from Muir Beach Overlook

activities.name: Feldtmann Loop Section 4 / Greenstone Ridge: Hike from Island Mine to Windigo
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1 Day)
activities.description: Walk along an old mining road on the western end of the Greenstone Ridge then descend to Windigo. Mileage: About 6.5 miles

activities.name: Visit Hartwell Tavern
activities.description: Hartwell Tavern is a restored 18th century home located along the Battle Road in Minute Man National Historical Park. Hartwell Tavern is open in June and July 2025 Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday. August 2025 hours will be announced soon!

activities.name: Take a Short Hike Near the Visitor Center
activities.basis: estimated from duration (15-30 Minutes)
activities.description: Near the Olympic National Park Visitor Center, two short loop hikes take visitors through peaceful, green lowland forests.

activities.name: Explore Raspberry Island
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Take a leisurely walk along a boardwalk through the spruce bog on Raspberry Island accessible by private boat, vessel rental, or a tour on the MV SANDY from Rock Harbor on Isle Royale’s east end.

activities.name: Chalmette National Cemetery Audio Tour
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: This tour of the Chalmette National Cemetery shares a few of the thousands of stories of the men and women buried at the national cemetery, giving a voice to those who can no longer speak.

activities.name: Paddling the Blackstone
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Whether kayaking, canoeing, or paddle boarding, the Blackstone River and the remaining parts of the Blackstone Canal offer great places to get out on the water. There are numerous locations across the river valley which are great for paddling. Different locations can accommodate beginner and intermediate paddlers.

activities.name: Soak Up Spectacular Views at the Great Falls Overlooks
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Great Falls Park has many opportunities to explore history and nature, all in a beautiful 800-acre park only 15 miles from the Nation's Capital.

activities.name: Catch a glimpse of the fast Pronghorn gliding through the Hills
activities.description: Information about the Pronghorns of Wind Cave National Park.

activities.name: Big Spring Branch Trail
activities.description: Big Spring Branch Trail

activities.name: 4WD Medano Pass Primitive Road
activities.description: Drive a a 4WD around the eastern edge of the dunes then over a forested mountain pass. Be prepared for soft sand, creek crossings, and rocky terrain.

activities.name: Hike the River Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (20-30 Minutes)
activities.description: The River Trail is 0.8 miles long and connects the Sea Camp and Dungeness docks. It takes you through the maritime forest and provides a few views of the intracoastal waterway.

activities.name: Frazier Discovery Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Loft Mountain Wayside (mile 79.5) | Pets are not allowed on this hike. This hike features several picturesque overlooks as it passes through woodlands of varying ages on Loft Mountain.

activities.name: Whiteoak Falls (Lower)
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: PARK BOUNDARY | An easier hike to the base of the lower falls in Whiteoak Canyon. Note that a Park entrance fee is still required.

activities.name: Hiking Glorieta Pass Battlefield
activities.basis: estimated from duration (90-150 Minutes)
activities.description: Hiking the 2.25-mile Glorieta Pass Battlefield Trail will lead you through part of New Mexico's Civil War history. The trail leads to sites where fighting occurred in March 1862.

activities.name: Hike the Painted Canyon Nature Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-80 Minutes)
activities.description: Painted Canyon Trail is a 1-mile loop trail located just off Interstate 94 near the Painted Canyon Visitor Center. It offers a great introduction to Theodore Roosevelt National Park, whether visitors are just passing through or planning on a multi-day stay.

activities.name: Splash in Medano Creek
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-8 Hours)
activities.description: Medano Creek is a popular seasonal stream enjoyed by all ages.

activities.name: Hike the Anza Trail from Tumacácori to Tubac, AZ
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-6 Hours)
activities.description: Hike through shady cottonwood galleries and mesquite bosques along this six-mile stretch of the Anza Trail between Tumacácori National Historic Park and Tubac Presidio State Historic Park.

activities.name: Collect Potomac Heritage NST Passport Stamps in Pennsylvania
activities.description: Are you a "Passport to Your National Parks" cancellation stamp collector? The Potomac Heritage National Scenic Trail has a cancellation stamp to commemorate your visit along the Trail in Pennsylvania.

activities.name: Horseback Riding in City of Rocks
activities.description: Horseback riding can be one of the best ways to experience much of the Reserve's backcountry.

activities.name: Driving, Biking, and Walking at Manzanar
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: The site is open during daylight hours, see it on foot or via the 3.2 mile driving tour road.

activities.name: Visit The Star Fort Historic Zone
activities.description: Learn how to visit the Star Fort historic zone!

activities.name: Attend a Ranger Program
activities.description: Attending a Ranger program is a fun and interactive way to enhance your visit!

activities.name: Learn about Giant Sequoias
activities.description: Before you investigate the area, stop here at the Giant Forest Museum to learn about giant sequoias and area history.

activities.name: Exhibits, Artifacts, & Park Films
activities.description: There are several videos available at the park visitor center that detail the history of the American Revolution in the Mohawk Valley.

activities.name: Enjoy a Scenic Drive on Trail Ridge Road
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-2 Hours)
activities.description: Enjoy a scenic drive across Trail Ridge Road in Rocky Mountain National Park. Trail Ridge Road is 48-miles one-way and connects the towns of Grand Lake and Estes Park during the summer season.

activities.name: Sledding at the Roadrunner Picnic Area
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Roadrunner Picnic area is an excellent place to go sledding with friends and family at White Sands National Park.

activities.name: Start at Arches Visitor Center
activities.description: Stop at the visitor center to plan your visit, fill your water bottle, learn about the park, and pick up a souvenir.

activities.name: Drive to the Five Points Vista
activities.description: Located line of sight to Dog Canyon, the Five Points Vista is a scenic overlook near the end of the Guadalupe Rim Road in the Lincoln National Forest's Guadalupe Ranger District. This viewpoint offers spectacular views of the 'Rim' and the Guadalupe Mountains.

activities.name: Travel the Tour Road at Wilson's Creek
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: A 4.9-mile paved road for driving, walking, or cycling loops through Wilson's Creek National Battlefield, once of the most pristine Civil War sites in the nation. Along the tour road you'll see historic structures and farm fields, artillery placements, the historic Wire Road, and the iconic Bloody Hill.

activities.name: Campground Connector Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (10-20 Minutes)
activities.description: This short trail connects the visitor center to the campground and the trailhead area at Pine Springs.

activities.name: Junior Ranger booklet- free
activities.description: Greenbelt Park Junior ranger booklet

activities.name: The Notch
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The hike to "the Notch" is a challenging day hike that proceeds through McKittrick Canyon to a dramatic viewpoint about half way up toward McKittrick Ridge.

activities.name: The Legacy of George Washington Carver
activities.description: Explore the impactful life of Carver at the museum and discovery area. Tour exhibits of his art, examine artifacts from his scientific work, and watch the park film, “Struggle and Triumph: The Legacy of George Washington Carver”. Learn about Carver’s contribution to science, education, agriculture, and more!

activities.name: Hike Contact Mine
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-3 Hours)
activities.description: Enjoy a secluded hike to a historic mining site.

activities.name: Become a Fort Smith Junior Ranger
activities.description: Complete a Junior Ranger booklet to earn an official Fort Smith Junior Ranger badge!

activities.name: Walk Crystal Forest Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (20-120 Minutes)
activities.description: Walk Crystal Forest Trail for one of the best opportunities to experience the petrified wood deposits as it loops through rolling gray and purple badlands.

activities.name: Explore the Iron Making in Colonial America Museum Exhibit
activities.description: The museum exhibit Forging a Nation: Iron Making in Colonial America features artifacts from the 18th century iron industry and puts the industry in the context of the American Revolution.

activities.name: Fountain Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (10-25 Minutes)
activities.description: This short trail begins on Fountain Street below the entrance to Hot Springs Mountain Drive. Use it to reach Honeysuckle Trail by crossing the road.

activities.name: Rinconada Canyon
activities.basis: estimated from duration (90-120 Minutes)
activities.description: Details about the hike in Rinconada Canyon.

activities.name: Hike to Snake Creek Overlook
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Snake Creek Overlook trail is a nice, short trail that will work one's legs with a stretch of elevation gain. This easy, 1.1 mile trip provides sweeping views of the lower valley and is a great start or end of the day

activities.name: Flamingo Boat Tours
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Flamingo is the launching point for water excursions into Everglades National Park. Whitewater Bay and Florida Bay offer abundant wildlife and a chance to visit the parts of the Everglades only accessible by boat.

activities.name: Photography in Timucuan
activities.description: The Timucuan Ecological and Historic Preserve is a stunning location for photography enthusiasts. With its winding drives canopied by majestic oaks, rich wildlife, and historical significance, there’s no shortage of incredible scenes to capture. Here’s why it’s a fantastic spot for photographers and what you need to…

activities.name: Bike the Davison/Streelow Creek Loop
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2 Hours)
activities.description: Start at a meadow where elk gather before biking through dense, Douglas-fir forests that have grown back since the old-growth redwoods were logged here in the 1960s. Along this trail you will pass old logging mill buildings and will see stumps of giant redwood trees set amongst the skinny, young and crowded…

activities.name: Paddle Friendsville MD to Confluence PA
activities.basis: estimated from duration (4-6 Hours)
activities.description: Launch at Friendsville, Maryland, and paddle 13.5 miles to Confluence, Pennsylvania, taking out above the dam. Best paddled with a touring kayak, you initially navigate some small rapids on the Youghiogheny River before entering the still water of the Lake. Outfitters in the area rent boats and offer shuttle services…

activities.name: Hike Boy Scout Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-10 Hours)
activities.description: Explore the Wonderland of Rocks on the Boy Scout Trail.

activities.name: Hike the Trails at Bartlett Cove
activities.description: Bartlett Cove has the only developed trails in the park. The forests and shorelines offer great hiking opportunities through a beautiful setting and a chance to see all manner of wildlife. Spend some time, stretch your legs, and discover the wonders of the park!

activities.name: Walk the Windigo Nature Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Walk the Windigo Nature Trail and immerse yourself in the deciduous forest on the western end of Isle Royale.

activities.name: Embrace Your Creativity
activities.description: Mental Wellness Challenge: Get creative, get inspired.

activities.name: Stargaze at Katahdin Woods and Waters National Monument
activities.description: Enjoy stargazing in an International Dark Sky Sanctuary with some of the darkest skies east of the Mississippi!

activities.name: Hike the Bell Point Loop
activities.description: The Bell Point trail traverses a mature madrona forest and hugs the shores of Garrison Bay and Westcott Bay.

activities.name: Start at Saddlehorn Visitor Center
activities.description: Begin your visit to Colorado National Monument at the visitor center. Watch the orientation film, explore the exhibit hall, shop for souvenirs at the park store, talk with a ranger, earn your Junior Ranger badge, and get your National Parks Passport stamp.

activities.name: Horseback Riding at Saratoga
activities.description: Ride on the historic grounds of the Saratoga Battlefield where in 1777, a large British invasion force met an equally large American army here. Visitors may bring their own horses to the battlefield unit and make use of our 7+ mile (round trip) Horse Trail.

activities.name: Take the Wellness Challenge at Ste. Genevieve National Historical Park
activities.description: Personal wellness is well within reach. Learn more about the National Park Service Wellness Challenge located at Ste. Genevieve National Historical Park.

activities.name: Portage from Lake Livermore to Lake LeSage
activities.description: Portage from Lake Livermore to Lake LeSage and travel over the Greenstone Ridge along the Indian Portage Trail.

activities.name: Tuskegee Airmen NHS Outdoor Activities
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Scenic Overlook is available for picnicking, relaxing, reflecting, and walking. From there you will enjoy a great view of the Historic Core where original buildings from the 1940's tell stories of times gone by. 20 Wayside Exhibits are strategically placed throughout the site that allow you to take a leisurely…

activities.name: Observe Wildlife at the Birthplace Unit
activities.description: Observe wildlife such as squirrls, deer, turkey, and so much more at the bench on the landing of the Pathway of a President.

activities.name: Oak Ridge: Enjoy the Community Swimming Pool
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-4 Hours)
activities.description: The Oak Ridge Community Swimming Pool, constructed during the Manhattan Project, remains a popular feature of the community to this day. Follow the link to learn more about operating hours, seasons, and fees.

activities.name: Old State House: Soak in Boston's History at this Former Seat of Government
activities.description: The Old State House's exhibits explore the founding of the United States as well as examine the legacies of the events surrounding the American Revolution.

activities.name: Carroll Rim Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: The Carroll Rim Trail is 1.6 miles (2.6 km) roundtrip. The trail climbs over 400 ft (120 m) of elevation to a panorama view of the Painted Hills.

activities.name: Portage from Lake LeSage to Lake Richie
activities.description: Portage 0.6 miles from Lake LeSage to Lake Richie over a rolling trail.

activities.name: Enjoy a Scenic Drive on Old Fall River Road
activities.duration: This is a scenic drive with a speed limit of 15-mph on a narrow, dirt road. Drivetime from the beginning of the road to the summit of Fall River Pass is approximately 2-hours.
activities.description: Built between 1913 and 1920, a drive up Old Fall River Road is an incredible 9.4-mile scenic drive. This unpaved road begins next to Endovalley Picnic Area and ends at the summit of Fall River Pass and in the parking area for Alpine Visitor Center. At Alpine Visitor Center, use Trail Ridge Road to return to the east…

activities.name: Island Loop Drive
activities.description: Jamestown has a one-way three/five mile scenic loop drive of the Island. This loop drive is open to pedestrians, bicycles and motor vehicles. Safety issues prohibit buses, motor homes or vehicles over 5-tons from using the Loop Drive. From the Historic Jamestowne parking lot, follow the signs to the loop drive. All…

activities.name: Mishe Mokwa Trail to Split Rock
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-3 Hours)
activities.description: Traversing riparian, coastal sage scrub, and chaparral, this trail offers wonderful views of Carlisle Canyon and Balanced Rock. Split Rock’s oak grove offers a shaded spot for picnicking.

activities.name: Los Alamos: Hike Kwage Mesa
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Typical of the amazing urban trail network that threads through Los Alamos, the Kwage Mesa Trail is an easy/moderate trek that provides the feeling of being miles away from town. The trail ascends gradually, leading you to the top of the Kwage Mesa. Follow the trail for spectacular views of surrounding mesas and…

activities.name: Guilford Courthouse National Military Park's monuments
activities.basis: estimated from duration (45-190 Minutes)
activities.description: There are 28 monuments at Guilford Courthouse National Military Park that commemorate the soldiers and commanders of the Battle of Guilford Courthouse, as well as the Signers of the Declaration of Independence, local figures, and the founders of the park.

activities.name: Greenstone Section 4: Hike from Chickenbone Lake to Hatchet Lake
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1 Day)
activities.description: Begin this trek with scenic views near Chickenbone Lake then travel through a variety of forest types to Hatchet Lake. Mileage: About 7.2 miles

activities.name: Chronic Sailing
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3-8 Hours)
activities.description: Step aboard a sailboat to explore the Chesapeake Bay. Chronic Sailing offers hands-on sailing experiences from Annapolis that showcase scenic coves, lighthouses, and maritime history. Guests can learn sailing skills, paddle quiet waters, and discover the Bay’s natural and cultural treasures from the unique vantage…

activities.name: Explore Sutro Baths and Sutro Heights Park
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-3 Hours)
activities.description: Explore the Sutro Bath Ruins and Sutro Heights Park

activities.name: Hike to the Grove Of Titans
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: A trail in the north that has an elevated metal boardwalk to protect the forest floor. Interpretive waysides explore the area's human and natural history. There is no parking for recreational vehicles or vehicles towing trailers.

activities.name: Crack-In-Rock Ranger-Led Hike
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Crack-In-Rock hikes are led by park staff and are only accessible by reservations offered by the park. This strenuous hike provides an opportunity to visit Ancestral Puebloan structures and view petroglyph panels.

activities.name: Cross-country Skiing at Black Canyon
activities.description: In winter, South Rim Drive is closed to vehicles beyond the visitor center at Gunnison Point. As staffing and snow conditions allow, rangers groom the remainder of the road for cross-country skiing (skate and classic) and snowshoeing.

activities.name: Explore the Ice House Museum
activities.description: Make a pitstop at the Ice House Museum to learn about the island’s history. Fill up your water bottle at the water bottle filling station and use the restrooms before heading on to Dungeness.

activities.name: Visit the Mississippi River Visitor Center
activities.description: The Mississippi River Visitor Center provides fun activities for people of all ages as well as highlighting the fascinating human history of the Mississippi River. This a great place to start your exploration of this important river!

activities.name: Stony Man
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: MILE 41.7 | Pets are not allowed on this hike. This enjoyable hike brings you to an outstanding view of the Shenandoah Valley, Massanutten Mountain, and beyond.

activities.name: Hike the Big Fill Loop Trail
activities.description: 1.5 mile hiking trail that showcases construction techniques for the transcontinental railroad.

activities.name: Hike the Lower Cliff Dwelling Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-90 Minutes)
activities.description: The Lower Cliff Dwelling Trail begins in the visitor center and winds up the side of a mountain. It ends in the Lower Cliff Dwelling where visitors can walk through portions of the structure. Along the trail are views of the cliff dwelling, various desert plants, and Roosevelt Lake. This trail is open year-round, but…

activities.name: Shop for Souvenirs at the Visitor Center
activities.description: Stop in to chat with a Ranger or pick up maps, guide booklets, and other informative resources. We offer souvenirs such as books, mugs, apparel, postcards, stickers and more.

activities.name: Pikas
activities.description: The American pika, a member of the order Lagomopha, is not a rodent, but related to rabbits and hares. Piles of drying vegetation, called haystacks, and a distinctive high-pitched call are the most recognizable indicators of active pika habitat. Pikas are sensitive to temperatures above 77.9°F (25.5°C); therefore…

activities.name: Winter Driving in RMNP
activities.description: Learn About Winter Driving in Rocky Mountain National Park

activities.name: Tour Cedar Creek Battlefield
activities.description: Follow the Battle of Cedar Creek on a self-guided driving tour, from where the Confederate soldiers surprised the sleeping Federal camps in the foggy dawn of October 19, 1864 to the final counterattack late that afternoon. This 17.5-mile tour has 9 stops.

activities.name: Birding at Point Reyes National Seashore
activities.description: Point Reyes National Seashore offers some of the finest birding in the United States. About 54% of all North American bird species have been observed in Point Reyes National Seashore. Learn about where to look for birds and what kinds of birds you might find at the seashore.

activities.name: Catoctin Junior Ranger Program
activities.description: Come explore Catoctin Mountain Park with our Junior Ranger Book!

activities.name: Picnic at Fort Larned
activities.description: Pack a picnic lunch and make a day of your visit to Fort Larned!

activities.name: Take a Drive on the Battlefield Tour Road
activities.description: Explore Saratoga National Historical Park and the Saratoga Battlefield by car, where turning point of the American Revolution took place in 1777.

activities.name: Hike Rampart Ridge
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-3 Hours)
activities.description: This loop trail explores the forest around Longmire, with glimpses of Mount Rainier and the Nisqually River Valley.

activities.name: Birdwatching at Fort Pulaski
activities.description: Explore birdwatching opportunities at Fort Pulaski National Monument.

activities.name: Hike Cadillac Summit Loop
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: The Cadillac Summit Loop, located on the eastern side of Mount Desert Island, is well known as one of the most scenic paths at Acadia National Park. Starting at the top of Cadillac Mountain, which is accessible via car, this path provides a walk with breathtaking 360-degree views of Frenchman Bay, the Porcupine…

activities.name: East Mesa Ranger-Led Hike
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-4 Hours)
activities.description: The East Mesa Hike is a unique opportunity for visitors to experience the backcountry of Wupatki with a ranger and see excellent examples of Ancestral Puebloan structures, petroglyphs, and artifacts.

activities.name: Hike the Jakle's Lagoon Nature Trail
activities.description: This 1 mile trail is an excellent place to take young people to learn more about our environment. Informational waysides along the trail describe the diverse forest ecosystem here.

activities.name: Catamaran Epiphany Sailing Charters
activities.description: Catamaran Epiphany Sailing Charters offers small group sailing experiences from St. Michaels, Maryland. Guests explore the Miles River and Chesapeake Bay while learning about maritime history, estuarine ecology, wildlife, and the importance of conserving the Bay through personalized interpretation aboard a…

activities.name: Walk the Morning Attack Trails
activities.basis: estimated from duration (30-60 Minutes)
activities.description: The three trails combined are 1.7 miles long. All three are on national park land. Pick up a free trail guide at the trail entrances or at the Visitor Center. The guide follows numbered stops marked on the trails.

activities.name: Crescent Meadow Wildlife
activities.description: Keep your eyes and ears open for wildlife as you hike along the Crescent Meadow in trail Sequoia's Giant Forest.

activities.name: Consider Deterrence and Destruction at Delta-09
activities.basis: estimated from duration (10-30 Minutes)
activities.description: Gaze Armageddon in the face with a visit to the Delta-09 missile silo. The viewing enclosure over the silo allows for visitors to gaze directly down at a Minuteman II missile. Consider the meaning of 1.2 megatons of destructive power hidden in plain sight.

activities.name: Float from Damascus to Skinners Falls
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Float this short stretch of river from Damascus River Access to Skinners Falls River Access. This stretch is approximately 3 river miles and takes on average 1.5 hours to float. This stretch of river has no rapids, only riffles and thus should be a relatively peaceful float.

activities.name: Visit the Friends of Pullman National Historical Park Pullman Exhibit Hall
activities.description: Visit the Historic Pullman Exhibit Hall located at Cottage Grove and 112th Street. Volunteers and partners from the Friends of Pullman National Historical Park are on-hand to answer questions and provide suggestions on how to enjoy your visit to the Historical Park. There are informational displays, artifacts and an…

activities.name: Carter G. Woodson Home NHS Bookstore
activities.description: Visitors can visit the site bookstore to purchase merchandise at the Carter G. Woodson Home National Historic Site's Visitor Center.

activities.name: Get Technical
activities.description: The combination of a working railroad yard and a world-class railroad museum gives visitors a chance to do more than just step back in time. Steamtown's Technology Museum is a visitor favorite, providing an immersive experience into the lights, sounds, and technology of the railroading industry.

activities.name: Hike Jordan Pond Loop with Island Explorer Bus
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: If looking for a way to relax, to take in some magnificent views, or to just burn some of the calories from the popovers consumed at the Jordan Pond house, the Jordan Pond Path is a great choice. Even just walking along the eastern shoreline is a certain way to enjoy some scenic vistas of one of Acadia’s iconic…

activities.name: Minong Section 2: Hike from Todd Harbor to Little Todd
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Enjoy scenic views of interior lakes, Lake Superior, and Canada on this strenuous, primitive trail. Mileage: About 6.8 miles

activities.name: Peer Into the Past at the Carter G. Woodson Home
activities.description: The Carter G. Woodson Home National Historic Site is one of the newest units of the National Park Service. Acquired in 2005, the historic home was restored and opened to the public in 2017, and the restoration of the remaining structures is expected to be complete in 2022.

activities.name: Driving the Hole in the Rock Road
activities.description: The Hole-in-the-Rock road is an historic pioneer trail turned path to adventure. This 62 mile (100 km) one-way section runs from Escalante, UT to the western edge of Lake Powell. This road is rough, impassable in inclement weather, and 4WD only for the last 7 miles. Along the way are quite a few trailheads for the…

activities.name: Cochran Shoals Fitness Loop
activities.description: The Cochran Shoals Fitness Loop is a true multi-use trail. You'll find mothers pushing strollers, joggers avoiding the afternoon traffic, and cyclist in their cool p-jays.

activities.name: Biking at Chamizal National Memorial
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: With over a mile and a half of maintained trails, it's easy and fun to explore Chamizal National Memorial by bike!

activities.name: Hike Alamo Canyon
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: The Alamo Canyon Trail follows an old road to a historic ranch house and corral, and provides ample wildlife and wildflower viewing opportunities.

activities.name: Bonita Creek Trail
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Winding along Bonita Creek, usually dry, this trail connects the Bonita Creek and Faraway Ranch Picnic Areas. Look for wild animals, including migrating birds, deer, coatimundi, and javelina. This is an easy 1/2 mile trail.

activities.name: Sand Creek Ranger Talk
activities.description: The Sand Creek ranger talk discusses the events of the mid 1800's and describes some of the social, economic, and political factors that contributed to the Sand Creek Massacre. Please note that this is a stationary talk, not a walking tour.

activities.name: Become a Jr. Ranger and Jr. Trader at Fort Union
activities.description: Kids of all ages are invited to explore Fort Union Trading Post NHS through the Junior Ranger & Junior Trader programs! Pick up a free Junior Ranger booklet at the Bourgeois House Visitor Center. The program typically takes around 1 hour to complete.

activities.name: Park Passport Stamps at Fort Smith NHS
activities.description: Stamp your passport! Stamps are available inside the visitor center lobby at Fort Smith National Historic Site.

activities.name: American Camp History Walk
activities.description: Embark on a captivating 1 mile guided walk through San Juan Island National Historical Park, where you can relive the intriguing events of the Pig War. Interpretive waysides provide historical insight into the life of soldiers at American Camp.

activities.name: Explore the Georgetown Waterfront
activities.basis: estimated from duration (60-160 Minutes)
activities.description: Explore the Georgetown Waterfront and imagine the changes the space has gone through.

activities.name: Hike Voyageurs Forest Overlook Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (10-30 Minutes)
activities.description: This short trail takes you through a section of forest revealing the changes in the forest at different elevations. Growing trees have blocked the overlook that used to be at the parking area. There are picnic tables and grills by the parking area.

activities.name: Explore Bard Rock
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Bard Rock is a picnic area and one of the only places within the park that visitors can gain such proximity to the Hudson River. Historically, it was a river landing with “a large flat rock, which forms a natural wharf” capable of accommodating large sloops. From here, you can observe some of the natural features that…

activities.name: Hike Winnakee Nature Preserve
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: Welcome to Hyde Park’s backyard! The Winnakee Nature Preserve is a community treasure, with over 100 acres of pristine woodland providing habitats for a surprising array of wildlife. Explore the woods where FDR developed his interest in forestry. Hear the stories of the Hyde Park volunteers who worked to preserve this…

activities.name: Become a Hot Springs Junior Ranger
activities.description: Kids visiting Hot Springs National Park may earn a Junior Ranger badge by completing a number of activities as they explore the park. The Junior Ranger booklet is available at the Fordyce Bathhouse Visitor Center.

activities.name: Hike the Humpback Rocks Trail (Milepost 6.0)
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: This fun and rewarding hike to the top of Humpback Rock will be sure to get your heart pumping! The trail is steep and quite rocky in places so be sure to watch your step and have appropriate footwear. The trail is marked with a blue-blaze ***Please stay on the official blue-blazed trail***

activities.name: Explore Temporary Exhibits in the Longfellow House
activities.description: Temporary exhibits in a gallery inside the historic house use the rich museum collections at the site, including objects usually in storage, to explore theme's related to the site's history. On exhibit beginning May 2025: "Washington’s Headquarters and the Memory of the American Revolution"

activities.name: Tour the 1797 Manor House
activities.description: Belle Grove offers guests tours of the region's premier authentic antebellum plantation. Tours last 45 minutes to one hour. Tickets for tours do not require advanced reservations.

activities.name: Visit Fort Pulaski's Visitor Center
activities.description: The best place to start your visit to Fort Pulaski!

activities.name: Tour the Thomas Stone House
activities.description: Join a ranger for a 30 minute guided tour of the Thomas Stone House to explore Thomas Stone's life as a planter, a lawyer, a politician, and a signer of the Declaration of Independence.

activities.name: Marys Rock From Meadow Spring
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-3 Hours)
activities.description: MILE 33.5 | This alternate route to Marys Rock Summit offers an easier and shorter trek to the same incredible westward views of the Shenandoah Valley. Along the way, hikers will pass by the remnants of the former Meadow Spring Shelter as well as beautiful azalea blooms in season.

activities.name: Spring Canyon Water Activities
activities.description: Spring Canyon is a water area east of the Sanford Dam.

activities.name: Bike the Big Sandy Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (4-8 Hours)
activities.description: Take your mountain bike on a 14.7-mile roundtrip trail through the woods of the Big Sandy Creek Unit. See different kinds of forest habitats along the way.

activities.name: Get Started at the Visitor Center
activities.description: Start your visit at the Visitor Center, where park rangers are available to answer questions and help you get oriented. Allow yourself up to 30 minutes in the Visitor Center, which is open from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. daily.

activities.name: Visit the Eastern National Park Store
activities.description: Looking for a gift or souvenir to remember your visit to Cape Cod National Seashore? Look no further than the park's Eastern National Bookstore, located in the Salt Pond Visitor Center. The park has an excellent selection of books, clothing, trinkets, and other fun items to represent Cape Cod National Seashore.

activities.name: Fish Manzanita Lake
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Manzanita Lake is one of the most popular fishing spots in the park and it is easily accessible. This lake holds a fair number of rainbow and brown trout and is rated as a blue-ribbon fly fishery by the state of California Department of Fish and Game.

activities.name: View the Park Film: Rendezvous with History
activities.description: The park film runs daily at the Henry Wallace Visitor & Education Center. The 140-seat theater features a high-definition film written and produced by Tom Spain Productions. The twenty minute film, "Rendezvous with History," features interviews with two of the Roosevelt grandchildren, Curtis Roosevelt and Anna Eleanor…

activities.name: Get a Backcountry Camping Permit
activities.description: Get away from the developed areas of Great Basin National Park and find a campsite nestled deep in the mountains of the backcountry.

activities.name: Visit the Foothills Visitor Center
activities.description: This visitor center is one mile past the Ash Mountain entrance station along the Generals Highway. Stop here for information, maps, books, gifts, and restrooms. Browse exhibits about the ecology and human history of the foothills, and join a free ranger-led program.

activities.name: Ebey's Reserve - The Jacob & Sarah Ebey House
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-4 Hours)
activities.description: The Jacob and Sarah Ebey House is open to the public from Memorial Day through Labor Day, and staffed by volunteer docents. Interpretive information is available along the trail and at the house.

activities.name: Hike the Jemez River Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (2-3 Hours)
activities.description: The Jemez River Trail (formerly Hidden Valley Trail) is a 3.4-mile round-trip hike into a picturesque canyon along the East Fork Jemez River. The hike takes 1-2 hours. Pets are not permitted.

activities.name: Guadalupe Peak
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Climb to the "Top of Texas" with a hike up Guadalupe Peak. Guadalupe Peak is a rewarding, although very strenuous, 8.4 mile round trip hike with a 3,000 foot elevation gain. It will take from six to eight hours to complete the hike. The peak provides fantastic views from the highest point in the state of Texas (8,751…

activities.name: Marys Rock Summit
activities.basis: estimated from duration (3-4 Hours)
activities.description: MILE 31.6 | Many legends surround the name of this hike, but there is no denying the beautiful westward views that it provides of the Shenandoah Valley and Massanutten Mountain.

activities.name: Trails and Rails: Klondike Seattle
activities.basis:

activities.name: Hike and Bike Westside Road in Mount Rainier
activities.duration: Duration can be a quick visit to several days.
activities.description: Hike or bike Westside Road through a dynamic landscape that is evidence of outburst floods that closed this portion of road to public vehicle traffic. Hike the trails that lead off this road lead to meadows, views of glaciers, and historic patrol cabins.

activities.name: Brooks Overlook
activities.description: Brooks Overlook is a favorite viewing spot for visitors and locals. There is a pair of Bald eagles that reside, year round, on Brooks Island and catching a glimpse of them is sure to spark delight.

activities.name: Drive South Puerto Blanco Road
activities.description: South Puerto Blanco Drive is a two-way, graded dirt road that follows the southern boundary of the park and provides access to Senita Basin and Quitobaquito Springs. Great examples of organ pipe, senita, and saguaro cacti are visible along this route. This road can be washboarded – reduce your speed and allow extra…

activities.name: Moderate Hike into Haleakalā's Crater
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Enter the park's Wilderness on the Keoneheʻeheʻe (Sliding Sands) Trail and take a moderate out-and-back hike partway down the windswept cinder slope. This is among the most popular hikes in the park thanks to its unbeatable crater views.

activities.name: Hike the Ledges Trail
activities.basis: estimated from duration (1-2 Hours)
activities.description: The Ledges Trail circles a plateau of striking rock formations and provides stunning views along the way. Learn more about hiking this popular trail.

activities.name: Explore Historic Carroll Homestead
activities.description: Head towards the west side of the island to visit an example of 1800s island life at Carroll Homestead, a time capsule of early Euro-american settlement before Mount Desert Island became a tourist destination and Acadia National Park came into being.

activities.name: Death Canyon - Static Peak Divide Junction
activities.basis: described by the park
activities.description: Travel into the Teton Range on this strenuous day or overnight hike to Death Canyon.

activities.name: Hike High Peaks to Balconies Cave Loop
activities.basis: estimated from duration (4-5 Hours)
activities.description: West Side Trails, Stenuous Hikes, Loop Hike

activities.name: Hiking in Valles Caldera

activities.description: Hiking routes within Valles Caldera range from flat strolls through montane grasslands to steep climbs on forested lava domes.
